modules.summary: HedgeFundAnalyzer computes strategy-specific metrics, 2/20 fee calculation, a single-factor and multi-factor least-squares regression and liquidity analysis. HedgeFundPortfolio handles diversification and correlation.
modules.relevance_note: Alpha and betas come from np.linalg.lstsq without standard errors or t-stats. Survivorship bias appears only as verdict text, with no data correction.
modules.summary_es: HedgeFundAnalyzer calcula métricas específicas por estrategia, el cálculo de comisiones 2/20, una regresión de mínimos cuadrados de un factor y multifactorial, y análisis de liquidez. HedgeFundPortfolio se encarga de la diversificación y la correlación.

modules.summary: LeveragedFundAnalyzer shows the volatility decay of daily-rebalanced 2x/3x ETFs and gives a verdict.
modules.relevance_note: Illustrates the leverage and variance-drag mechanics behind Kelly sizing but computes no optimal leverage.
modules.summary_es: LeveragedFundAnalyzer muestra el decaimiento por volatilidad de los ETFs 2x/3x con rebalanceo diario y emite un veredicto.

modules.summary: ManagedFuturesAnalyzer covers price-vs-MA (20/50/100/200) long/short trend-following stats, crisis alpha from user-entered crisis periods, 2/20 fee drag, correlation with stocks and bonds, and replication alternatives.
modules.relevance_note: A single-asset time-series trend rule evaluated gross of trading costs: only the 2/20 fee drag is modeled, and separately. It reports four lookbacks' Sharpe ratios side by side with no correction for picking the best one.
modules.summary_es: ManagedFuturesAnalyzer cubre estadísticas de seguimiento de tendencia largo/corto basadas en el precio frente a la MA (20/50/100/200), el alfa en crisis a partir de periodos de crisis ingresados por el usuario, el lastre de comisiones 2/20, la correlación con acciones y bonos, y alternativas de replicación.

modules.summary: MarketNeutralAnalyzer covers beta neutrality, correlation-based exposure to user-supplied HML/SMB/UMD factor returns, short-squeeze and leverage scenarios, and alpha versus expectations.
modules.relevance_note: Measures factor exposure with simple correlations against externally supplied factor series, not a joint regression with alpha t-stats. Short-squeeze risk is scenario-based and uses no short-interest data.
modules.summary_es: MarketNeutralAnalyzer cubre la neutralidad de beta, la exposición basada en correlación a rendimientos de factores HML/SMB/UMD proporcionados por el usuario, escenarios de short squeeze y de apalancamiento, y el alfa frente a las expectativas.

modules.summary: PerformanceAnalyzer covers TWR/MWR, risk-adjusted returns, attribution, downside metrics, rolling performance, factor-exposure regression, benchmark analysis and rank-correlation performance persistence. FeeAnalyzer covers fee impact.
modules.relevance_note: performance_persistence (rank correlation across periods) is the closest the area comes to fund-persistence research. It runs no significance or false-discovery test.
modules.summary_es: PerformanceAnalyzer cubre TWR/MWR, rendimientos ajustados por riesgo, atribución, métricas de riesgo a la baja, desempeño móvil, regresión de exposición a factores, análisis contra benchmark y persistencia del desempeño mediante correlación de rangos. FeeAnalyzer cubre el impacto de las comisiones.

modules.summary: RiskAnalyzer covers historical, parametric and Monte Carlo VaR, stress scenarios, rolling correlation and breakdown, a liquidity score with a volume/market-cap impact proxy, drawdown and recovery, ulcer index and factor risk attribution.
modules.relevance_note: Classifies market impact only as Low/Medium/High from volume and market-cap ratios. It produces no basis-point cost model that a backtest could use.
modules.summary_es: RiskAnalyzer cubre VaR histórico, paramétrico y Monte Carlo, escenarios de estrés, correlación móvil y su ruptura, un puntaje de liquidez con un proxy de impacto por volumen/capitalización de mercado, drawdown y recuperación, índice Ulcer y atribución de riesgo por factores.

modules.summary: Backtesting.py provider: event-driven run_backtest with commission and margin, built-in optimize (grid with max_tries), and walk_forward that optimizes on each train slice and evaluates on the test slice; reports SQN and the Kelly Criterion stat.
modules.relevance_note: Proper train-optimize/test walk-forward. Commission defaults to 0.0 when not sent and there is no slippage model. Optimization results get no multiple-testing deflation.
modules.summary_es: Proveedor de Backtesting.py: run_backtest orientado a eventos con comisión y margen, optimize integrado (cuadrícula con max_tries) y walk_forward, que optimiza en cada tramo de entrenamiento y evalúa en el tramo de prueba. Reporta SQN y la estadística del Criterio de Kelly.

modules.summary: Extended backtesting.py optimization: grid search with heatmap extraction, compute_stats on trades, and a walk-forward optimizer.
modules.relevance_note: Parameter heatmaps support visual robustness checks, but there is no formal overfitting statistic (PBO/DSR).
modules.summary_es: Optimización extendida de backtesting.py: búsqueda en cuadrícula con extracción del mapa de calor, compute_stats sobre las operaciones y un optimizador walk-forward.

modules.summary: Strategy class factories for backtesting.py (SMA/EMA crossover, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, z-score mean reversion, momentum, Donchian breakout, ADX, Ichimoku, PSAR, dual momentum, ATR trailing stop, trend-momentum).
modules.relevance_note: The same family of single-asset technical and trend rules re-implemented per engine, so the same hypothesis gets tested several times across providers.
modules.summary_es: Fábricas de clases de estrategia para backtesting.py (cruce de SMA/EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, reversión a la media con z-score, momentum, ruptura de Donchian, ADX, Ichimoku, PSAR, momentum dual, trailing stop con ATR, tendencia-momentum).

modules.summary: Shared post-backtest analytics computed from an equity curve: VaR/CVaR, Ulcer, Omega, tail ratio, skew and kurtosis, a monthly returns table, rolling Sharpe/vol/drawdown, and single-index Jensen alpha, beta, information ratio, tracking error and R2 against a benchmark.
modules.relevance_note: Describes a single backtest path only: CAPM alpha and beta come without standard errors or t-stats, and there is no Sharpe inference, trial-count deflation or factor-model (FF/q) alpha.
modules.summary_es: Analítica compartida posterior al backtest calculada a partir de una curva de capital: VaR/CVaR, Ulcer, Omega, tail ratio, asimetría y curtosis, una tabla de rendimientos mensuales, Sharpe/volatilidad/drawdown móviles, y alfa de Jensen, beta, information ratio, tracking error y R2 de índice único frente a un benchmark.

modules.summary: Universal runner that loads a QuantConnect-style strategy class from the strategies/_registry (about 400 algorithm files), fetches history and replays it bar by bar to produce performance, fills and equity.
modules.relevance_note: Engine behind the 400+ strategy catalog, which is a large pool of candidate strategies. Results are gross and carry no record of how many strategies or parameter sets were tried.
modules.summary_es: Ejecutor universal que carga una clase de estrategia al estilo QuantConnect desde strategies/_registry (cerca de 400 archivos de algoritmos), obtiene el historial y lo reproduce barra por barra para generar desempeño, ejecuciones y curva de capital.

modules.summary: bt library provider for portfolio-level backtests (composable algos), with a pure-numpy fallback simulation, optimize, walk_forward, signals/labels/splits and analyze_returns.
modules.relevance_note: Commission defaults to 0.001 per dollar traded through bt. The numpy fallback charges commission on np.diff across assets within one day's signal vector rather than over time, so single-asset fallback runs are effectively cost-free.
modules.summary_es: Proveedor de la biblioteca bt para backtests a nivel portafolio (algos componibles), con una simulación de respaldo en numpy puro, optimize, walk_forward, signals/labels/splits y analyze_returns.

modules.summary: bt risk and constraint strategies: TargetVol scaling, LimitWeights, LimitDeltas (caps per-rebalance weight change), PTE tracking-error-triggered rebalance, capital flows, notional, hedge and margin/leverage.
modules.relevance_note: The real volatility-targeting implementation (bt.algos.TargetVol) and turnover throttling (LimitDeltas). Neither reports realised turnover or cost drag.
modules.summary_es: Estrategias de riesgo y restricciones de bt: escalamiento TargetVol, LimitWeights, LimitDeltas (limita el cambio de ponderación por rebalanceo), rebalanceo disparado por tracking error con PTE, flujos de capital, nocional, cobertura y margen/apalancamiento.

modules.summary: Registry of bt strategies: equal-weight, inverse-vol, mean-variance, risk-parity (WeighERC), 'target_vol', 'min_var', momentum top-N (SelectMomentum), momentum plus inverse-vol, plus SMA/EMA/MACD/RSI/Bollinger/breakout rules.
modules.relevance_note: Holds the only cross-sectional momentum selection among the engines (monthly, 60-day lookback, no 12-1 skip). Two strategies are mislabelled: 'target_vol' ignores targetVol (plain equal weight) and 'min_var' uses WeighMeanVar (max-Sharpe), not minimum variance.
modules.summary_es: Registro de estrategias de bt: ponderación igual, volatilidad inversa, media-varianza, paridad de riesgo (WeighERC), 'target_vol', 'min_var', momentum top-N (SelectMomentum), momentum más volatilidad inversa, además de reglas SMA/EMA/MACD/RSI/Bollinger/ruptura.

modules.summary: Fast-Trade provider: JSON-defined rule backtests on 90+ FINTA indicators, with summary metrics (risk, drawdown, trade quality, market-adjusted return vs buy-and-hold), commission-aware entries and exits, and rule-based result evaluation.
modules.relevance_note: Single-run technical-rule backtests with per-trade commission. optimize() raises NotImplementedError, so there is no walk-forward or validation.
modules.summary_es: Proveedor Fast-Trade: backtests de reglas definidas en JSON sobre más de 90 indicadores de FINTA, con métricas resumen (riesgo, drawdown, calidad de las operaciones, rendimiento ajustado al mercado frente a comprar y mantener), entradas y salidas que consideran las comisiones, y evaluación de resultados basada en reglas.

modules.summary: Provider that runs Fincept Engine registry strategies, with grid or random parameter optimization and a fixed-parameter rolling walk-forward that reports average OOS return and Sharpe and a 'robustness_score' (fraction of positive folds).
modules.relevance_note: Gross backtest: commission, slippage and total_fees are hard-coded to 0.0. The optimizer picks the in-sample best Sharpe with no trial-count haircut, and walk-forward does not re-optimize on each train window.
modules.summary_es: Proveedor que ejecuta estrategias del registro de Fincept Engine, con optimización de parámetros por cuadrícula o aleatoria y un walk-forward móvil con parámetros fijos que reporta el rendimiento y el Sharpe promedio OOS y un 'robustness_score' (fracción de pliegues positivos).

modules.summary: Technical indicator and signal generators (MA, MSTD, BBANDS, RSI, STOCH, MACD, ATR, OBV, ADX, Donchian, z-score, momentum, Williams %R, CCI, Keltner, VWAP) with crossover, threshold, breakout and mean-reversion signal builders and an IndicatorFactory.
modules.relevance_note: Building blocks for technical-rule backtests and the indicator_param_sweep grid, which is another source of multiple testing.
modules.summary_es: Generadores de indicadores técnicos y señales (MA, MSTD, BBANDS, RSI, STOCH, MACD, ATR, OBV, ADX, Donchian, z-score, momentum, Williams %R, CCI, Keltner, VWAP) con constructores de señales de cruce, umbral, ruptura y reversión a la media, y un IndicatorFactory.

modules.summary: Label generators for supervised ML (fixed-horizon forward-return FIXLB, mean-reversion MEANLB, local extrema LEXLB, trend TRENDLB, Bollinger BOLB) and labels_to_signals.
modules.relevance_note: Builds forward-looking targets for single-asset ML. labels_to_signals turns look-ahead labels into signals, which is an oracle and not a tradable backtest. There is no cross-sectional ML model here.
modules.summary_es: Generadores de etiquetas para ML supervisado (rendimiento futuro a horizonte fijo FIXLB, reversión a la media MEANLB, extremos locales LEXLB, tendencia TRENDLB, Bollinger BOLB) y labels_to_signals.

modules.summary: Full metrics extraction from a portfolio: performance, trade analysis, drawdowns, returns, risk, plus extended stats (SQN, Kelly, CAGR, 'deflatedSharpe', streaks).
modules.relevance_note: 'deflatedSharpe' is mislabelled. It is SR*sqrt(1 - skew*SR + (kurt-1)/4*SR^2), with no number-of-trials adjustment and no probability output. Kelly is estimated from realised trades.
modules.summary_es: Extracción completa de métricas de un portafolio: desempeño, análisis de operaciones, drawdowns, rendimientos y riesgo, además de estadísticas extendidas (SQN, Kelly, CAGR, 'deflatedSharpe', rachas).

modules.summary: Grid or random parameter search with sensitivity (parameter-objective correlation), walk-forward optimize (train-optimize, test-evaluate per window), IS-to-OOS degradation ratio, and a z-score 'significance' of the best vs all tested combos.
modules.relevance_note: Has real walk-forward and a degradation ratio. The 'statisticalSignificance' block is a naive z-test of the best combo vs the tested distribution (best-of-N selection bias, not a data-snooping-robust test), and grid search truncates to max_iterations.
modules.summary_es: Búsqueda de parámetros por cuadrícula o aleatoria con sensibilidad (correlación parámetro-objetivo), optimización walk-forward (optimiza en entrenamiento y evalúa en prueba en cada ventana), razón de degradación de IS a OOS y una 'significance' por z-score de la mejor combinación frente a todas las combinaciones probadas.

modules.summary: Pure numpy/pandas portfolio simulator (from_signals, from_orders, holding, random signals) with commission and slippage, stops, and position sizing modes fixed, kelly, volatility-target and fractional, plus a random-entry benchmark generator.
modules.relevance_note: Nets proportional commission and slippage, but both default to 0.0 when absent from the request. Kelly f = p - (1-p)/(W/L) uses user-supplied winRate/avgWin/avgLoss clipped to [0,1]. Vol targeting is 20-day realised vol scaled to targetVol, clipped to 0.1-3x.
modules.summary_es: Simulador de portafolio en numpy/pandas puro (from_signals, from_orders, holding, señales aleatorias) con comisión y deslizamiento, stops y modos de dimensionamiento de posición fijo, kelly, objetivo de volatilidad y fraccional, además de un generador de benchmark de entradas aleatorias.

modules.summary: Re-implementation of vectorbt's ReturnsAccessor: annualized return and vol, Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, Omega, information ratio, capture ratios, rolling metrics and deflated_sharpe_ratio(n_trials).
modules.relevance_note: Only true DSR in the repo, but simplified: E[max SR] = sqrt(2 ln N)(1 - gamma/(2 ln N)) is not scaled by the cross-trial SR variance, and an annualized SR is mixed with a per-observation SR variance.
modules.summary_es: Reimplementación del ReturnsAccessor de vectorbt: rendimiento y volatilidad anualizados, Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, Omega, information ratio, razones de captura, métricas móviles y deflated_sharpe_ratio(n_trials).

modules.summary: Time-series CV splitters: Range, Rolling, Expanding and a Lopez de Prado-style PurgedKFoldSplitter with purge and embargo.
modules.relevance_note: Leakage-aware validation splits (exposed through generate_splits). It does not implement CSCV/CPCV path combinations or PBO.
modules.summary_es: Divisores de CV para series de tiempo: Range, Rolling, Expanding y un PurgedKFoldSplitter al estilo de Lopez de Prado con purga y embargo.

modules.summary: Library of about 25 single-asset signal strategies (SMA/EMA/triple-MA crossovers, MACD, ADX, Keltner/Donchian/volatility breakouts, RSI/BB/stochastic mean reversion, ROC momentum, 'dual momentum', periodic rebalance, custom combos).
modules.relevance_note: Classic technical and trend rules of the Brock-Lakonishok-LeBaron type. 'Dual momentum' is really two-horizon absolute (time-series) momentum on one asset, with no cross-sectional relative leg.
modules.summary_es: Biblioteca de cerca de 25 estrategias de señales para un solo activo (cruces SMA/EMA/triple MA, MACD, ADX, rupturas de Keltner/Donchian/volatilidad, reversión a la media con RSI/BB/estocástico, momentum ROC, 'dual momentum', rebalanceo periódico, combinaciones personalizadas).

modules.summary: VectorBT orchestrator (VectorBTProvider) exposing run_backtest, optimize, walk_forward, generate_signals/labels/splits, analyze_returns (including a Deflated Sharpe stat with a user n_trials) and an optional random-entry benchmark p-value.
modules.relevance_note: The only provider that exposes DSR (analyze_returns, n_trials defaults to 1) and a Monte Carlo random-signal p-value. Neither is fed by the optimizer's real number of tried combinations.
modules.summary_es: Orquestador de VectorBT (VectorBTProvider) que expone run_backtest, optimize, walk_forward, generate_signals/labels/splits, analyze_returns (incluida una estadística de Deflated Sharpe con n_trials definido por el usuario) y un valor p opcional contra un benchmark de entradas aleatorias.

modules.summary: Event-driven Zipline-reloaded provider with a full mock API (order types, PerShare/PerTrade/PerDollar commission, Fixed/VolumeShare/FixedBasisPoints slippage, leverage and long-only controls) plus optimize and walk_forward.
modules.relevance_note: Richest cost model in the area (per-dollar commission default 0.001, volume-share price-impact slippage, max leverage). The default universe is a single symbol (SPY).
modules.summary_es: Proveedor de Zipline-reloaded orientado a eventos con una API simulada completa (tipos de orden, comisión PerShare/PerTrade/PerDollar, deslizamiento Fixed/VolumeShare/FixedBasisPoints, controles de apalancamiento y de solo posiciones largas), además de optimize y walk_forward.

modules.summary: Simulation of Zipline's Pipeline API: Factor/Filter/Classifier with rank, quantiles, deciles, zscore, winsorize and demean, plus built-ins such as Returns, AverageDollarVolume, SimpleBeta, AnnualizedVolatility, RSI and rolling regressions.
modules.relevance_note: Holds the cross-sectional sort machinery (deciles, winsorize, a liquidity factor, beta) needed for anomaly, BAB and momentum portfolios and liquidity or microcap screens, but no strategy actually uses it on a multi-asset universe.
modules.summary_es: Simulación de la API Pipeline de Zipline: Factor/Filter/Classifier con rank, quantiles, deciles, zscore, winsorize y demean, además de elementos integrados como Returns, AverageDollarVolume, SimpleBeta, AnnualizedVolatility, RSI y regresiones móviles.

modules.summary: Zipline (initialize, handle_data) strategy pairs: SMA/EMA/MACD/ADX/triple-MA/Keltner trend, BB/RSI/z-score/stochastic/Williams/CCI mean reversion, ROC and dual momentum, Donchian and volatility breakouts, 'pipeline' and 'scheduled_rebalance'.
modules.relevance_note: The 'Custom Pipeline' strategy is advertised as factor-based ranking but is a single-asset 1-month time-series momentum switch. scheduled_rebalance is 63-day absolute momentum (TSMOM).
modules.summary_es: Pares de estrategias de Zipline (initialize, handle_data): tendencia con SMA/EMA/MACD/ADX/triple MA/Keltner, reversión a la media con BB/RSI/z-score/estocástico/Williams/CCI, momentum ROC y dual, rupturas de Donchian y de volatilidad, 'pipeline' y 'scheduled_rebalance'.

modules.summary: M&A and corporate-finance toolkit with 57 files: DCF, football field, precedent transactions, LBO, merger models, synergies, deal structure (earnouts, CVR, collars), fairness opinion, startup valuation, a deal database, and Monte Carlo and regression analytics for deals.
modules.relevance_note: Mostly outside the literature-review categories: these are deal-level valuations, not return-predictive signals or portfolio backtests.
modules.summary_es: Kit de herramientas de M&A y finanzas corporativas con 57 archivos: DCF, football field, transacciones precedentes, LBO, modelos de fusión, sinergias, estructura de la transacción (earnouts, CVR, collars), fairness opinion, valuación de startups, una base de datos de transacciones, y analítica de Monte Carlo y de regresión para transacciones.

modules.summary: TradingCompsAnalyzer pulls yfinance fundamentals for peers, computes EV/EBITDA, P/E and other multiple statistics, applies them to a target, and regresses a multiple on margin.
modules.relevance_note: Deal-oriented relative valuation with no link to value-factor return evidence.
modules.summary_es: TradingCompsAnalyzer obtiene fundamentales de yfinance para empresas comparables, calcula EV/EBITDA, P/E y estadísticas de otros múltiplos, los aplica a una empresa objetivo y hace una regresión de un múltiplo sobre el margen.

modules.summary: Utilities for business days, Black-Scholes delta and gamma, interpolation, root-finders, and StatisticalUtils (rolling vol, EWMA vol, GARCH(1,1), correlation, Jarque-Bera).
modules.relevance_note: garch_volatility hard-codes omega/alpha/beta (1e-6, 0.10, 0.85) instead of estimating them. EWMA uses lambda=0.94. The forecasts never drive volatility-targeted exposure.
modules.summary_es: Utilidades para días hábiles, delta y gamma de Black-Scholes, interpolación, buscadores de raíces y StatisticalUtils (volatilidad móvil, volatilidad EWMA, GARCH(1,1), correlación, Jarque-Bera).

modules.summary: StatisticalAnalyzer (descriptives, correlation p-values, hypothesis tests, ADF and autocorrelation), ScenarioAnalyzer (Monte Carlo, sensitivity, stress), seasonality decomposition and ForecastingEngine (naive, mean, trend, ETS, ARIMA).
modules.relevance_note: _find_significant_correlations flags every pair with p<0.05 without multiple-testing correction. Forecast comparison has no Clark-West or out-of-sample R2 test against the historical mean.
modules.summary_es: StatisticalAnalyzer (estadística descriptiva, valores p de correlación, pruebas de hipótesis, ADF y autocorrelación), ScenarioAnalyzer (Monte Carlo, sensibilidad, estrés), descomposición de estacionalidad y ForecastingEngine (naive, media, tendencia, ETS, ARIMA).

modules.summary: Snapshot of market proxies (S&P, VIX, 3m/10y/30y yields, gold, oil, DXY), with the 10y-3m spread inversion flag, gold/oil ratio, S&P vs 50/200-day SMA, and VIX sentiment buckets.
modules.relevance_note: A point-in-time dashboard. It has no historical recession-probability (probit) model, no regime estimation and no backtest of the SMA-200 timing flag.
modules.summary_es: Instantánea de proxies de mercado (S&P, VIX, rendimientos a 3m/10y/30y, oro, petróleo, DXY), con la señal de inversión del diferencial 10y-3m, la razón oro/petróleo, el S&P frente a sus SMA de 50/200 días y categorías de sentimiento según el VIX.

modules.summary: Estimates the ERP several ways: 10y and 5y historical S&P excess return, earnings-yield-minus-10y, supply-side (dividend + buyback + growth + inflation), and a VIX heuristic, then averages them into a 'consensus'.
modules.relevance_note: Point estimates with hard-coded inputs (buyback 2%, growth 2.5%) and VIX/100*0.5. It has no CAPE, no Goyal-Welch predictor set and no out-of-sample predictive regression.
modules.summary_es: Estima la ERP de varias formas: exceso de rendimiento histórico del S&P a 10y y 5y, rendimiento por utilidades menos el 10y, enfoque del lado de la oferta (dividendos + recompras + crecimiento + inflación) y una heurística con el VIX. Luego las promedia en un 'consensus'.

modules.summary: BusinessCycleAnalyzer scores expansion, peak, contraction and trough from user-supplied GDP, unemployment, inflation, rates, confidence and investment, and rates sector cyclicality. CreditCycleAnalyzer and a market-structure (HHI) analyzer are also included.
modules.relevance_note: Rule-based scoring of regimes, with no HMM or Markov-switching estimation and no validation against NBER dates.
modules.summary_es: BusinessCycleAnalyzer asigna puntajes a expansión, pico, contracción y valle a partir de PIB, desempleo, inflación, tasas, confianza e inversión proporcionados por el usuario, y califica la ciclicidad de los sectores. También incluye CreditCycleAnalyzer y un analizador de estructura de mercado (HHI).

modules.summary: Ratio calculators: profitability (gross, operating and net margin, ROE, ROA, ROIC, NOPAT), liquidity, solvency, efficiency, DuPont 3- and 5-way, and cost of equity, each with threshold interpretations.
modules.relevance_note: Scores one firm at a time. It has no gross-profits-to-assets (GP/A), no QMJ composite and no cross-sectional quality ranking or portfolio returns.
modules.summary_es: Calculadoras de razones: rentabilidad (margen bruto, operativo y neto, ROE, ROA, ROIC, NOPAT), liquidez, solvencia, eficiencia, DuPont de 3 y 5 componentes, y costo de capital propio, cada una con interpretaciones basadas en umbrales.

modules.summary: P/E, P/B, P/S, PEG, dividend and earnings yield, justified multiples, EV multiples, comparables screening, harmonic-mean statistics and a cross-sectional P/E regression.
modules.relevance_note: Valuation-screen building blocks for a single company. It does not form HML-style book-to-market portfolios or test value returns.
modules.summary_es: P/E, P/B, P/S, PEG, rendimiento por dividendos y por utilidades, múltiplos justificados, múltiplos de EV, selección de comparables, estadísticas con media armónica y una regresión transversal del P/E.

modules.summary: Residual income and EVA/MVA valuation, implied growth, justified P/B from ROE, ROE sustainability and an accounting-quality assessment.
modules.relevance_note: Links profitability (ROE) to P/B valuation at firm level, with no factor-return backtest.
modules.summary_es: Valuación por ingreso residual y por EVA/MVA, crecimiento implícito, P/B justificado a partir del ROE, sostenibilidad del ROE y una evaluación de la calidad contable.

modules.summary: Index construction (price-, cap- and equal-weighted), index value and return calculation, rebalancing and reconstitution, and index comparison and composition analysis.
modules.relevance_note: Supports 1/N versus cap-weight comparisons, but rebalancing ignores turnover and costs.
modules.summary_es: Construcción de índices (ponderados por precio, por capitalización y equiponderados), cálculo del valor y del rendimiento del índice, rebalanceo y reconstitución, y comparación de índices y análisis de su composición.

modules.summary: Weak-form tests (runs, autocorrelation, variance ratio), event-study/PEAD, insider and mutual-fund Jensen-alpha tests, and MarketAnomalyDetector for day-of-week, month-of-year, January, size-decile and momentum-decile anomalies.
modules.relevance_note: The most anomaly-like code in the area, but every test is a raw t-test at p<0.05. It runs 5 weekday, 12 month and 1 January tests and per-fund alpha t-stats with no Bonferroni/Holm/BHY or FDR. The 'momentum' deciles sort one asset's own overlapping 12-1 returns, which is time-series momentum rather than cross-sectional WML, and tests them without Newey-West. No CLI or caller invokes the module.
modules.summary_es: Pruebas de eficiencia en forma débil (rachas, autocorrelación, razón de varianzas), estudio de eventos/PEAD, pruebas de alfa de Jensen para insiders y fondos de inversión, y MarketAnomalyDetector para anomalías de día de la semana, mes del año, enero, decil de tamaño y decil de momentum.

modules.summary: Security classification, margin trading calculator, order-type analysis, and microstructure, liquidity and depth analysis, including estimate_trading_costs (half-spread plus a volume-scaled impact proxy).
modules.relevance_note: The area's only explicit trading-cost estimator, and it is standalone: no backtest subtracts these costs from returns. The margin calculator covers leverage arithmetic, not optimal sizing.
modules.summary_es: Clasificación de valores, calculadora de operaciones con margen, análisis de tipos de orden, y análisis de microestructura, liquidez y profundidad, incluido estimate_trading_costs (medio spread más un proxy de impacto escalado por volumen).

modules.summary: FFN JSON service: performance stats, drawdowns, rolling metrics, monthly returns, asset comparison, risk metrics, portfolio optimization (ERC, inverse vol, mean-var, equal) and benchmark comparison.
modules.relevance_note: Descriptive performance and static weights. ffn's calc_prob_mom (probabilistic momentum) is wrapped in ffn_performance.py but not exposed here.
modules.summary_es: Servicio JSON de FFN: estadísticas de desempeño, drawdowns, métricas móviles, rendimientos mensuales, comparación de activos, métricas de riesgo, optimización de portafolio (ERC, volatilidad inversa, media-varianza, ponderación igual) y comparación contra benchmark.

modules.summary: CLI that parses JSON financial statements and runs the income, balance, cash-flow, comprehensive and key-metrics analyzers from finanicalanalysis.
modules.relevance_note: The entry point for quality and profitability metrics, though FinancialReportingQualityAnalyzer (Beneish) is not exposed as a command.
modules.summary_es: CLI que interpreta estados financieros en JSON y ejecuta los analizadores de estado de resultados, balance general, flujo de efectivo, integral y métricas clave de finanicalanalysis.

modules.summary: FinancialReportingQualityAnalyzer covers earnings quality, balance-sheet and cash-flow accruals, the Beneish M-score, balance-sheet, cash-flow, revenue and expense quality, red flags and an overall quality grade.
modules.relevance_note: The area's richest earnings-quality and accrual logic (Beneish, accrual ratios). It has no Piotroski F-score, no Novy-Marx GP/A and no testing of accrual-anomaly returns.
modules.summary_es: FinancialReportingQualityAnalyzer cubre la calidad de las utilidades, los devengos del balance y del flujo de efectivo, el Beneish M-score, la calidad del balance, del flujo de efectivo, de los ingresos y de los gastos, señales de alerta y una calificación general de calidad.

modules.summary: Income-statement, balance-sheet, cash-flow and comprehensive analyzers that produce margin, ROE, accruals-ratio, leverage and composite financial-health scores.
modules.relevance_note: Firm-level quality and profitability diagnostics (an accruals ratio with good/moderate/poor thresholds). They do not rank stocks cross-sectionally.
modules.summary_es: Analizadores de estado de resultados, balance general, flujo de efectivo e integral que generan márgenes, ROE, razón de devengos, apalancamiento y puntajes compuestos de salud financiera.

modules.summary: Spot-curve bootstrapping, forward curves, Nelson-Siegel and Svensson fits, interpolation, curve-shape classification (normal, inverted, flat) and G/I/Z-spread and OAS analysis.
modules.relevance_note: Supplies term-spread and inversion inputs, but it does not link curve slope to recession probabilities or equity-premium forecasts.
modules.summary_es: Bootstrapping de la curva spot, curvas forward, ajustes de Nelson-Siegel y Svensson, interpolación, clasificación de la forma de la curva (normal, invertida, plana) y análisis de spreads G/I/Z y OAS.

modules.summary: Risk-aware optimization service: portfolio metrics, covariance/correlation matrices, mean-variance and mean-CVaR optimization, efficient frontier and exponential-decay scenario probabilities.
modules.relevance_note: An alternative Markowitz/CVaR allocator with time-decayed scenario weights. No out-of-sample evaluation or cost model.
modules.summary_es: Servicio de optimización consciente del riesgo: métricas de portafolio, matrices de covarianza/correlación, optimización media-varianza y media-CVaR, frontera eficiente y probabilidades de escenarios con decaimiento exponencial.

modules.summary: Time-series CV utilities: blocked CV, purged k-fold with embargo, combinatorial purged CV, walk-forward validation and nested CV over panel data.
modules.relevance_note: Generates CPCV splits (the prerequisite for PBO/CSCV) for forecasting models but never computes PBO or the rank-logit distribution.
modules.summary_es: Utilidades de CV para series de tiempo: CV por bloques, k-fold purgado con embargo, CV purgado combinatorio, validación walk-forward y CV anidado sobre datos de panel.

modules.summary: Additional forecasters: naive, seasonal naive, drift, SES, Holt, Theta, Croston, and gradient-boosted XGBoost and CatBoost on lag features.
modules.relevance_note: GBDT return/price forecasting on a single series's own lags. Not cross-sectional characteristic-based ML (Gu-Kelly-Xiu style) and not evaluated as a trading strategy.
modules.summary_es: Pronosticadores adicionales: naive, naive estacional, drift, SES, Holt, Theta, Croston, y XGBoost y CatBoost de gradient boosting sobre variables de rezago.

modules.summary: Polars walk-forward backtest with optional retraining, rolling-origin evaluation, model comparison and per-horizon accuracy attribution for time-series forecasters.
modules.relevance_note: Proper walk-forward out-of-sample evaluation, but only functime_service_polars_legacy.py (the 'walk_forward' operation) calls it, and nothing in src/ or any other script calls that legacy service, so in practice it is unreachable. It measures forecast error only, not strategy returns, costs or trial counts.
modules.summary_es: Backtest walk-forward en Polars con reentrenamiento opcional, evaluación con origen móvil, comparación de modelos y atribución de la precisión por horizonte para pronosticadores de series de tiempo.

modules.summary: Forecasting backend used by the AI Quant Lab and by MCP. It covers forecasts (linear, ridge, lasso, elastic net, kNN, Holt-Winters, ARIMA, naive and drift on lags), z-score/IQR/IsolationForest anomalies, STL seasonality strength, bootstrap or residual prediction intervals, and stationarity tests.
modules.relevance_note: Seasonality here is generic STL decomposition, not a calendar-anomaly test. Forecasts are for a single series with no walk-forward evaluation; the walk-forward code lives in functime_wrapper/backtesting.py, which only the unused legacy service calls.
modules.summary_es: Backend de pronósticos que usan el AI Quant Lab y MCP. Cubre pronósticos (lineal, ridge, lasso, elastic net, kNN, Holt-Winters, ARIMA, naive y drift sobre rezagos), anomalías por z-score/IQR/IsolationForest, fuerza de la estacionalidad con STL, intervalos de predicción por bootstrap o por residuales, y pruebas de estacionariedad.

modules.summary: Probabilistic forecasting: GluonTS deep models (DeepAR, TFT, WaveNet, DLinear, PatchTST, TiDE, Lag-TST, DeepNPTS) plus a self-contained service with bootstrap probabilistic and quantile forecasts, distribution fitting and forecast evaluation.
modules.relevance_note: Deep-learning time-series forecasting for single series. No cross-sectional ranking, portfolio formation or economic (Sharpe) evaluation of forecasts.
modules.summary_es: Pronóstico probabilístico: modelos profundos de GluonTS (DeepAR, TFT, WaveNet, DLinear, PatchTST, TiDE, Lag-TST, DeepNPTS) más un servicio autocontenido con pronósticos probabilísticos por bootstrap y por cuantiles, ajuste de distribuciones y evaluación de pronósticos.

modules.summary: BacktestEngine with commission (10 bps) and slippage (5 bps) defaults, running buy-and-hold, periodic rebalancing, cross-sectional momentum top-N and mean-reversion backtests with strategy comparison.
modules.relevance_note: Cost-netted by default, unlike most engines here. The momentum is a 20-day lookback top-N cross-sectional sort with no 12-1 skip month and no risk adjustment.
modules.summary_es: BacktestEngine con valores predeterminados de comisión (10 pb) y deslizamiento (5 pb), que ejecuta backtests de comprar y mantener, rebalanceo periódico, momentum transversal top-N y reversión a la media, con comparación de estrategias.

modules.summary: Dispatcher for gs_quant-style ops: risk_metrics, portfolio_analytics, greeks, var_analysis, stress_test, backtest (buy-and-hold, single-winner momentum, mean reversion, rebalancing with commission) and statistics.
modules.relevance_note: _bt_momentum holds only the single top trailing performer, with daily rebalance and commission on both sides. That is concentrated relative momentum, not decile WML.
modules.summary_es: Despachador de operaciones al estilo gs_quant: risk_metrics, portfolio_analytics, greeks, var_analysis, stress_test, backtest (comprar y mantener, momentum de un solo ganador, reversión a la media, rebalanceo con comisión) y statistics.

modules.summary: Offline gs_quant.timeseries portfolio analytics: CAPM and Jensen alpha (incl. bull/bear), Treynor, M2, tracking error and IR (bull/bear), capture ratios, hit rate, factor exposure, factor PnL and factor proportion of risk, basket backtest.
modules.relevance_note: portfolio_factor_exposure runs separate univariate cov/var betas per factor, not a joint multivariate regression. It gives no alpha intercept, t-stat or HAC errors, so it cannot test FF/q-factor alpha.
modules.summary_es: Analítica de portafolio offline con gs_quant.timeseries: CAPM y alfa de Jensen (incluido mercado alcista/bajista), Treynor, M2, tracking error e IR (alcista/bajista), razones de captura, tasa de aciertos, exposición a factores, PnL por factor y proporción del riesgo atribuible a factores, y backtest de canastas.

modules.summary: gs-quant-style time-series risk functions: rolling and EWMA volatility, downside risk, drawdown length and recovery, Sharpe/Sortino/Calmar/Omega, forward volatility and variance term structure, vol-swap volatility and VaR.
modules.cli_entry: python gs_quant_service.py risk_metrics '<json>' (uses volatility, sharpe_ratio, max_drawdown and value_at_risk, but not exponential_volatility)
modules.relevance_note: Provides the EWMA volatility forecast that volatility management needs, but no module uses it to scale exposure and the service's risk_metrics operation does not return it. Sharpe has no standard error and no trial adjustment.
modules.summary_es: Funciones de riesgo de series de tiempo al estilo gs-quant: volatilidad móvil y EWMA, riesgo a la baja, duración del drawdown y recuperación, Sharpe/Sortino/Calmar/Omega, volatilidad forward y estructura temporal de la varianza, volatilidad de vol-swap y VaR.

modules.summary: Black-76 option-chain tools ported from OpenAlgo: GEX calculator, IV smile, IV surface, open-interest/PCR/max-pain tracker, intraday short-ATM-straddle simulator and multi-leg strategy payoff/greeks chart.
modules.relevance_note: Builds put-call ratio and implied-vol sentiment inputs (oriented to Indian F&O such as NIFTY). The straddle simulator P&L leaves out brokerage and slippage. There is no VIX term-structure or variance-risk-premium time series and no short-interest data.
modules.summary_es: Herramientas de cadena de opciones con Black-76 portadas de OpenAlgo: calculadora de GEX, sonrisa de IV, superficie de IV, seguimiento de interés abierto/PCR/max pain, simulador intradía de straddle corto ATM y gráfica de payoff/griegas de estrategias de varias patas.

modules.summary: Covers CFA-style active management: value added and its decomposition, ex-post/ex-ante information ratio, the Fundamental Law (IR = IC x sqrt(BR) x TC), APT/multifactor descriptions, active-risk decomposition and manager selection by IR.
modules.relevance_note: Significance of active return is tested with an i.i.d. t-stat against fixed normal critical values (1.645/1.96/2.576). It has no HAC errors, no multiple-testing haircut and no luck-versus-skill bootstrap. The factor-model sections are mostly descriptive dictionaries.
modules.summary_es: Cubre la gestión activa al estilo CFA: valor agregado y su descomposición, information ratio ex post/ex ante, la Ley Fundamental (IR = IC x sqrt(BR) x TC), descripciones de APT/multifactoriales, descomposición del riesgo activo y selección de gestores por IR.

modules.summary: 30-line stub with only a module docstring. It defines no classes or functions.
modules.relevance_note: Holds the place for retail/behavioral analysis but implements nothing. etf_analytics.py is the same kind of stub.
modules.summary_es: Stub de 30 líneas que solo contiene un docstring de módulo. No define clases ni funciones.

modules.summary: Maps a user-chosen business-cycle phase to policy, yield-curve, credit, earnings and real-estate implications, with ERP and normalized-multiple helpers.
modules.relevance_note: The regime is an input, not an estimate, and implications are hard-coded. It has no predictive regression and no out-of-sample R2.
modules.summary_es: Relaciona una fase del ciclo económico elegida por el usuario con sus implicaciones para la política, la curva de rendimientos, el crédito, las utilidades y los bienes raíces, con funciones auxiliares de ERP y de múltiplos normalizados.

modules.summary: Core math library: statistics (beta, tracking error, downside deviation), portfolio variance and minimum-variance portfolio, Sharpe/Treynor/IR/Jensen alpha/M2/Sortino, parametric/historical VaR/CVaR, efficient frontier and max-Sharpe optimizer.
modules.relevance_note: Gives point estimates of Sharpe and alpha with no standard errors, no PSR/DSR and no cost adjustment, and supports the minimum-variance (low-vol) construction.
modules.summary_es: Biblioteca matemática central: estadística (beta, tracking error, desviación a la baja), varianza del portafolio y portafolio de mínima varianza, Sharpe/Treynor/IR/alfa de Jensen/M2/Sortino, VaR/CVaR paramétrico/histórico, frontera eficiente y optimizador de máximo Sharpe.

modules.summary: Implements MPT tools (efficient frontier, CAL/CML, CAPM alpha, risk-aversion utility, correlation effects) and C++-callable commands for portfolio metrics, tax report, PME versus SPY and allocation analysis.
modules.relevance_note: Computes single-factor CAPM alpha and frontier statistics on 1y yfinance data, gross of costs, with no statistical-significance or overfitting controls.
modules.summary_es: Implementa herramientas de MPT (frontera eficiente, CAL/CML, alfa de CAPM, utilidad con aversión al riesgo, efectos de la correlación) y comandos invocables desde C++ para métricas de portafolio, reporte fiscal, PME frente a SPY y análisis de asignación.

modules.summary: Investor-type classification, rule-based lifecycle stages (accumulation, consolidation, spending, gifting), DC vs DB pension analysis, and descriptive mutual-fund and asset-management fee content.
modules.relevance_note: Lifecycle and fund content is qualitative lookup tables. It does no empirical fund-performance (SPIVA-style) or glide-path simulation.
modules.summary_es: Clasificación por tipo de inversionista, etapas del ciclo de vida basadas en reglas (acumulación, consolidación, gasto, donación), análisis de pensiones DC frente a DB, y contenido descriptivo sobre comisiones de fondos de inversión y de administración de activos.

modules.summary: Uses SciPy SLSQP on 1y yfinance sample means and covariance to solve max_sharpe, min_volatility, efficient_risk/return, quadratic utility, risk_parity, 'black_litterman' and 'hrp' weightings. Note: 'hrp' is plain inverse-variance weighting and 'black_litterman' has no views.
modules.relevance_note: Purely in-sample mean-variance optimization with no out-of-sample test, no 1/N benchmark comparison and no costs. Two methods are mislabeled: 'hrp' is plain inverse-variance weighting, and 'black_litterman' is the equilibrium prior from equal weights with no views.
modules.summary_es: Usa SciPy SLSQP sobre medias muestrales y covarianza de 1y de yfinance para resolver las ponderaciones max_sharpe, min_volatility, efficient_risk/return, utilidad cuadrática, risk_parity, 'black_litterman' y 'hrp'. Nota: 'hrp' es una simple ponderación por varianza inversa y 'black_litterman' no tiene views.

modules.summary: Builds IPS objectives and constraints, strategic asset allocation, risk-budgeting construction principles and ESG policy, and offers a retirement_planning command.
modules.relevance_note: retirement_planning is a deterministic projection (fixed 7% return, 3% inflation, 4% withdrawal rule). It has no Monte Carlo of wealth, no sequence-of-returns risk and no shortfall probability. The $2bn minimum-cap and no-penny-stock rules are IPS text, not data filters.
modules.summary_es: Construye objetivos y restricciones de la IPS, asignación estratégica de activos, principios de construcción con presupuesto de riesgo y política ESG, y ofrece un comando retirement_planning.

modules.summary: Risk governance plus parametric, Monte Carlo and component VaR, stress and historical scenario tests, a risk-budgeting system and a risk-tolerance capacity/willingness assessment.
modules.relevance_note: Measures risk and allocates a risk budget on static return samples. It does not forecast volatility or scale exposure to it.
modules.summary_es: Gobierno de riesgos más VaR paramétrico, Monte Carlo y por componentes, pruebas de estrés y de escenarios históricos, un sistema de presupuesto de riesgo y una evaluación de la tolerancia al riesgo por capacidad/disposición.

modules.summary: Public Market Equivalent wrapper (PME, xPME, verbose variants, Tessa market-data xPME) for comparing private-fund cash flows against a public index.
modules.relevance_note: Fund-vs-benchmark performance attribution for private equity (Kaplan-Schoar style). Nothing comparable (SPIVA, persistence, fee drag) exists for mutual funds or retail traders.
modules.summary_es: Wrapper de Public Market Equivalent (PME, xPME, variantes verbose, xPME con datos de mercado de Tessa) para comparar flujos de efectivo de fondos privados contra un índice público.

modules.summary: Extra PyPortfolioOpt-based allocators: minimum tracking error, 'risk parity', equal weight, market neutral, inverse volatility and maximum diversification.
modules.relevance_note: optimize_risk_parity is mislabelled: it returns inverse-volatility weights that ignore correlations, not equal risk contributions. It offers a 1/N allocator but no cost or turnover accounting, and performance uses a fixed 2% risk-free rate.
modules.summary_es: Asignadores adicionales basados en PyPortfolioOpt: mínimo tracking error, 'risk parity', ponderación igual, neutral al mercado, volatilidad inversa y máxima diversificación.

modules.summary: Extra PyPortfolioOpt objectives and constraints: custom objectives, sector constraints, tracking-error constraint, turnover constraint, L1 regularization, transaction-cost objective and views optimization.
modules.relevance_note: Transaction costs and turnover appear as ex-ante optimization penalties only. They are not linked to the backtest's realised P&L.
modules.summary_es: Objetivos y restricciones adicionales de PyPortfolioOpt: objetivos personalizados, restricciones sectoriales, restricción de tracking error, restricción de rotación, regularización L1, objetivo de costos de transacción y optimización con views.

modules.summary: PyPortfolioOptAnalyticsEngine: expected returns (historical, EMA, CAPM), risk models (sample, semicov, shrinkage), efficient frontier, HRP, Black-Litterman, CLA, semivariance/CVaR/CDaR optimization, discrete allocation, risk decomposition, sensitivity and a rolling-window backtest.
modules.relevance_note: backtest_strategy re-optimizes every 21 days on a 252-day window but reports gross returns with no turnover or transaction cost, so the comparison to 1/N (DeMiguel et al.) is not cost-aware.
modules.summary_es: PyPortfolioOptAnalyticsEngine: rendimientos esperados (históricos, EMA, CAPM), modelos de riesgo (muestral, semicovarianza, shrinkage), frontera eficiente, HRP, Black-Litterman, CLA, optimización por semivarianza/CVaR/CDaR, asignación discreta, descomposición del riesgo, sensibilidad y un backtest con ventana móvil.

modules.summary: Worker dispatcher exposing optimize, efficient_frontier, discrete_allocation, backtest, risk_decomposition, black_litterman, hrp, risk_parity, equal_weight, inverse_volatility, market_neutral, min_tracking_error, max_diversification, custom_constraints and views_optimization.
modules.relevance_note: UI entry point for the Markowitz, 1/N, risk parity, BL and HRP comparisons. Its backtest op returns gross Sharpe and Calmar only.
modules.summary_es: Despachador del worker que expone optimize, efficient_frontier, discrete_allocation, backtest, risk_decomposition, black_litterman, hrp, risk_parity, equal_weight, inverse_volatility, market_neutral, min_tracking_error, max_diversification, custom_constraints y views_optimization.

modules.summary: SkfolioCore builds skfolio optimizers: MeanRisk, RiskParity, HierarchicalRiskParity and NestedClustersOptimization, with BlackLitterman, FactorModel and EntropyPooling priors and bootstrap uncertainty sets. It fits on a chronological train split and predicts on the hold-out.
modules.relevance_note: The only skfolio path that evaluates out of sample (train_test_split with shuffle=False). WalkForward and CombinatorialPurgedCV are imported but optimize_portfolio does not use them, and transaction_costs only enter the optimizer objective, not the reported returns.
modules.summary_es: SkfolioCore construye optimizadores de skfolio: MeanRisk, RiskParity, HierarchicalRiskParity y NestedClustersOptimization, con priors BlackLitterman, FactorModel y EntropyPooling y conjuntos de incertidumbre por bootstrap. Ajusta sobre una partición de entrenamiento cronológica y predice sobre el conjunto reservado.

modules.summary: DataManager for multi-source loading (CSV, Excel, DB, yfinance), quality scoring, cleaning, outlier handling and return computation, plus create_factor_data building momentum, reversal, volatility, 'value' and 'size' factors from prices.
modules.relevance_note: Factor proxies are crude: 'value' = 1/price and 'size' = log(price). There are no book-to-market, market-cap or profitability fundamentals, so they are not HML/SMB.
modules.summary_es: DataManager para carga desde múltiples fuentes (CSV, Excel, DB, yfinance), puntuación de calidad, limpieza, manejo de valores atípicos y cálculo de rendimientos, además de create_factor_data, que construye factores de momentum, reversión, volatilidad, 'value' y 'size' a partir de precios.

modules.summary: OptimizationEngine wrapping skfolio models (MeanRisk, HRP, HERC, NCO, RiskBudgeting, MaxDiversification) with mu/covariance estimators (shrinkage, Ledoit-Wolf, OAS, denoise, detone, Gerber), priors (BlackLitterman, FactorModel), uncertainty sets, transaction costs and turnover limits, model comparison and frontier.
modules.relevance_note: Most complete Markowitz/1-N/shrinkage/HRP/BL toolkit. transaction_costs and max_turnover enter only as optimizer penalties and constraints, not as realised cost netting in a backtest.
modules.summary_es: OptimizationEngine que envuelve modelos de skfolio (MeanRisk, HRP, HERC, NCO, RiskBudgeting, MaxDiversification) con estimadores de mu/covarianza (shrinkage, Ledoit-Wolf, OAS, denoise, detone, Gerber), priors (BlackLitterman, FactorModel), conjuntos de incertidumbre, costos de transacción y límites de rotación, comparación de modelos y frontera.

modules.summary: PortfolioManager constructs constrained skfolio portfolios, computes one-off rebalance turnover (0.5*sum|w_new-w_old|) and per-asset transaction costs, monitors drawdowns and runs a periodic-rebalance backtest.
modules.relevance_note: rebalance_portfolio is one of the few places that measures turnover from weight changes, but its benefit test assumes a hard-coded expected improvement of turnover*0.001. backtest_portfolio is gross: weights never drift between rebalances, and total_costs and average_turnover are never updated from 0.
modules.summary_es: PortfolioManager construye portafolios de skfolio con restricciones, calcula la rotación de un rebalanceo único (0.5*sum|w_new-w_old|) y los costos de transacción por activo, monitorea drawdowns y ejecuta un backtest con rebalanceo periódico.

modules.summary: RiskAnalyzer computing VaR, CVaR, EVaR, CDaR, Ulcer, Gini, entropic risk, Sharpe/Sortino/Treynor/IR/alpha/beta, risk attribution, stress scenarios, risk budgets and copula-based Monte Carlo of portfolio returns.
modules.relevance_note: Monte Carlo covers a default 252-day horizon of portfolio returns. There is no multi-decade wealth or lifecycle (contribution/withdrawal) modelling.
modules.summary_es: RiskAnalyzer que calcula VaR, CVaR, EVaR, CDaR, Ulcer, Gini, riesgo entrópico, Sharpe/Sortino/Treynor/IR/alfa/beta, atribución de riesgo, escenarios de estrés, presupuestos de riesgo y un Monte Carlo de rendimientos del portafolio basado en cópulas.

modules.summary: skfolio worker exposing optimize (mean-risk, HRP, HERC, NCO, risk budgeting, max diversification, equal weight, inverse vol, DR-CVaR), efficient frontier, risk metrics, stress test, rolling backtest, strategy compare, hyperparameter tuning and walk-forward/CPCV model validation.
modules.relevance_note: op_backtest is a gross rolling max-Sharpe backtest (no costs or turnover) against a 1/N benchmark. op_validate_model runs CombinatorialPurgedCV but returns only fold metrics, with no PBO or DSR.
modules.summary_es: Worker de skfolio que expone optimize (media-riesgo, HRP, HERC, NCO, presupuesto de riesgo, máxima diversificación, ponderación igual, volatilidad inversa, DR-CVaR), frontera eficiente, métricas de riesgo, prueba de estrés, backtest móvil, comparación de estrategias, ajuste de hiperparámetros y validación de modelos walk-forward/CPCV.

modules.summary: ModelValidator with walk-forward, combinatorial purged CV, k-fold, hyperparameter tuning, paired t/Wilcoxon/Mann-Whitney model comparisons with Cohen's d, and an out-of-sample overfitting score (Sharpe/return degradation).
modules.relevance_note: Closest thing to a PBO framework (it generates CPCV paths) but stops at mean and std of scores and an ad-hoc degradation score. Pairwise model tests are not multiplicity-adjusted.
modules.summary_es: ModelValidator con walk-forward, CV purgado combinatorio, k-fold, ajuste de hiperparámetros, comparaciones de modelos con pruebas t pareada/Wilcoxon/Mann-Whitney y d de Cohen, y un puntaje de sobreajuste fuera de muestra (degradación del Sharpe/rendimiento).

modules.summary: DataValidator and DataQualityReport check structure, missing data, outliers, return patterns and price jumps, and validate date ranges, correlation matrices and portfolio weights.
modules.relevance_note: Data-hygiene step before backtests (outliers and jumps). It does not address survivorship or look-ahead bias.
modules.summary_es: DataValidator y DataQualityReport revisan la estructura, los datos faltantes, los valores atípicos, los patrones de rendimiento y los saltos de precio, y validan rangos de fechas, matrices de correlación y ponderaciones de portafolio.

modules.summary: AdvancedQuantAnalyzer covers trend and stationarity tests, ARIMA, forecasting, supervised ML (ridge/lasso/elastic-net/SVM/KNN/decision tree/random forest), unsupervised PCA/k-means, model evaluation with cross_val_score and learning curves, bootstrap/jackknife/permutation resampling, and CLT and sampling-error demos.
modules.relevance_note: The ML runs on lagged values of one time series, not a cross-section. The 80/20 split keeps time order, but cross_val_score uses unpurged KFold. 'Overfitting' means the train-validation R2 gap exceeds 0.1. There are no GBDT/NN models. The 'fama_french_5' default appears only in a boilerplate docstring.
modules.summary_es: AdvancedQuantAnalyzer cubre pruebas de tendencia y estacionariedad, ARIMA, pronósticos, ML supervisado (ridge/lasso/elastic-net/SVM/KNN/árbol de decisión/random forest), PCA/k-means no supervisados, evaluación de modelos con cross_val_score y curvas de aprendizaje, remuestreo bootstrap/jackknife/permutación, y demostraciones del CLT y del error muestral.

modules.summary: Unified CLI (CFAQuantEngine) that wraps quant_modules_3042 and DataValidator. It builds lag features from a ticker or series and runs trend, stationarity, ARIMA, ML, evaluation, sampling and validation commands.
modules.relevance_note: The entry point to the area's ML prediction. Fits are judged by R2 and accuracy, not by trading Sharpe or long-short spread returns, and there is no purged or embargoed CV.
modules.summary_es: CLI unificada (CFAQuantEngine) que envuelve quant_modules_3042 y DataValidator. Construye variables de rezago a partir de un ticker o de una serie y ejecuta comandos de tendencia, estacionariedad, ARIMA, ML, evaluación, muestreo y validación.

modules.summary: Formulas written with only the Python standard library: probabilistic and deflated Sharpe ratio, minimum backtest length, Harvey-Liu-Zhu Sharpe haircut and Bonferroni t-threshold, turnover cost drag and break-even cost, the Bodie shortfall put and probability of real loss, continuous Kelly, and the Campbell-Thompson gain.
modules.relevance_note: Added on this branch (commit 67acf5e). It is the repo's only deflated Sharpe that accounts for the number of trials, its only Harvey-Liu-Zhu haircut and its only continuous mu/sigma^2 Kelly. No backtest engine, optimizer or C++ screen calls it, and it does not implement PBO/CSCV.
modules.summary_es: Fórmulas escritas solo con la biblioteca estándar de Python: Sharpe ratio probabilístico y deflactado, longitud mínima del backtest, recorte del Sharpe de Harvey-Liu-Zhu y umbral t de Bonferroni, lastre de costos por rotación y costo de equilibrio, el put de shortfall de Bodie y la probabilidad de pérdida real, Kelly continuo y la ganancia de Campbell-Thompson.

modules.summary: JSON CLI over the quant evidence knowledge base. It lists strategies and categories, scores a proposed decision through quant_evidence/evaluator.evaluate_decision, exposes the stats helpers, returns the curated or live repo map, and exports web/decision_lab.html.
modules.relevance_note: The evaluate command scores a strategy after multiple testing, publication decay, microcap dependence and costs. No file in src/ or any other script references quant_evidence, so the evaluator is not connected to the app's backtests.
modules.summary_es: CLI JSON sobre la base de conocimiento de evidencia cuantitativa. Lista estrategias y categorías, califica una decisión propuesta mediante quant_evidence/evaluator.evaluate_decision, expone las funciones auxiliares de stats, devuelve el mapa del repositorio curado o en vivo y exporta web/decision_lab.html.

modules.summary: Downloads yfinance prices for a weighted ticker basket and benchmark, then computes 50+ quantstats metrics, drawdowns, rolling Sharpe/vol/beta, a bootstrap Monte Carlo of wealth paths, and an HTML tearsheet.
modules.relevance_note: This is the only place in the area that reports probabilistic_sharpe_ratio and kelly_criterion. Everything runs on gross buy-and-hold returns, with no deflated Sharpe, no adjustment for the number of trials and no costs; the Monte Carlo is an i.i.d. bootstrap of daily returns.
modules.summary_es: Descarga precios de yfinance para una canasta ponderada de tickers y un benchmark, y luego calcula más de 50 métricas de quantstats, drawdowns, Sharpe/volatilidad/beta móviles, un Monte Carlo por bootstrap de trayectorias de riqueza y un tearsheet en HTML.

modules.summary: RiskPortfolioAnalytics class whose calculate_var, calculate_cvar, stress_test and risk_budgeting methods are all empty ('pass').
modules.relevance_note: Non-functional stub. Riskfolio-based risk parity is not actually available at this path.
modules.summary_es: Clase RiskPortfolioAnalytics cuyos métodos calculate_var, calculate_cvar, stress_test y risk_budgeting están todos vacíos ('pass').

modules.summary: skfolio-based engine offering MeanRisk, RiskBudgeting, HRP, NestedClusters, EqualWeighted, InverseVolatility, Black-Litterman/FactorModel priors and LedoitWolf covariance, plus GridSearchCV tuning, a rolling walk-forward backtest, stress tests and strategy comparison.
modules.relevance_note: It imports WalkForward and CombinatorialPurgedCV but uses them only as the CV splitter for GridSearchCV (default cv_method is plain KFold). It never computes a PBO. backtest_strategy returns gross results, because transaction_costs only enter the MeanRisk objective and are never subtracted from realized returns. compare_strategies picks the best Sharpe in-sample without any haircut. The CLI 'backtest' command returns hard-coded placeholder metrics (Sharpe 0.83) taken from the bundled load_sp500_dataset.
modules.summary_es: Motor basado en skfolio que ofrece MeanRisk, RiskBudgeting, HRP, NestedClusters, EqualWeighted, InverseVolatility, priors Black-Litterman/FactorModel y covarianza LedoitWolf, además de ajuste con GridSearchCV, un backtest walk-forward móvil, pruebas de estrés y comparación de estrategias.

modules.summary: Statsmodels CLI exposing ARIMA/SARIMAX/ETS/STL, ADF/KPSS/ACF/PACF/Ljung-Box, OLS/diagnostics/logit/GLM, t-tests and power, Jarque-Bera, PCA, KDE and LOWESS.
modules.relevance_note: Generic OLS can run a factor regression, but the CLI passes only (y, X), so there is no HAC/Newey-West option. fit_markov_regression and rolling_ols are imported but missing from command_map, so regime switching is not reachable through the CLI.
modules.summary_es: CLI de Statsmodels que expone ARIMA/SARIMAX/ETS/STL, ADF/KPSS/ACF/PACF/Ljung-Box, OLS/diagnósticos/logit/GLM, pruebas t y potencia, Jarque-Bera, PCA, KDE y LOWESS.

modules.summary: OLS, WLS, GLS, GLSAR, recursive least squares, rolling OLS/WLS and regression diagnostics returning params, standard errors, t-values and p-values.
modules.relevance_note: Could run Fama-French time-series alpha regressions, but uses default (non-HAC) standard errors and has no factor-data loader.
modules.summary_es: OLS, WLS, GLS, GLSAR, mínimos cuadrados recursivos, OLS/WLS móviles y diagnósticos de regresión que devuelven parámetros, errores estándar, valores t y valores p.

modules.summary: Thin wrappers over about 100 statsmodels.stats functions, including multipletests, fdrcorrection, fdrcorrection_twostage, local_fdr, cov_nw_panel (panel Newey-West covariance), cov_white_simple and breaks_hansen.
modules.relevance_note: Together with stats_tests.multipletests_correction, these are the repo's only Bonferroni/Holm/BH/BY corrections and its only Newey-West helper. The module is imported as statsmodels_wrapper.stats_extended but is absent from statsmodels_service.OPERATIONS and from statsmodels_cli command_map, so nothing uses it. breaks_hansen is Hansen's parameter-instability test, not Hansen's SPA test.
modules.summary_es: Wrappers delgados sobre cerca de 100 funciones de statsmodels.stats, incluidas multipletests, fdrcorrection, fdrcorrection_twostage, local_fdr, cov_nw_panel (covarianza Newey-West para panel), cov_white_simple y breaks_hansen.

modules.summary: statsmodels hypothesis tests: t/z tests, ANOVA, normality, heteroskedasticity, autocorrelation, and multiple-testing p-value correction (multipletests: Bonferroni/Holm/BH/BY etc.) and two-stage FDR.
modules.relevance_note: The only Bonferroni/Holm/BHY-capable code in the area. It is not registered in statsmodels_service.OPERATIONS (ols, arima, stationarity_tests, acf_pacf, granger_causality, descriptive) and is not applied to any backtest or optimizer output.
modules.summary_es: Pruebas de hipótesis de statsmodels: pruebas t/z, ANOVA, normalidad, heterocedasticidad, autocorrelación, y corrección de valores p por pruebas múltiples (multipletests: Bonferroni/Holm/BH/BY etc.) y FDR en dos etapas.

modules.summary: Econometrics backend for the AI Quant Lab Statsmodels sub-tab, with the operations ols, arima, stationarity_tests, acf_pacf, granger_causality and descriptive.
modules.relevance_note: This is the statsmodels script the C++ app actually runs (AIQuantLabService kStatsmodelsScript). OLS reports t-stats with non-robust standard errors (no HAC). Granger causality is the only exposed predictability test. Multipletests, Markov regression and VARMAX are not registered.
modules.summary_es: Backend econométrico de la subpestaña Statsmodels del AI Quant Lab, con las operaciones ols, arima, stationarity_tests, acf_pacf, granger_causality y descriptive.

modules.summary: Time-series model fitting: ARIMA, SARIMAX, VARMAX, AutoReg, ARDL, exponential smoothing, STL, dynamic factor, unobserved components, Markov-switching regression and autoregression, VECM.
modules.relevance_note: Has Hamilton-type regime switching (smoothed regime probabilities) and VAR/ARDL predictive regressions, but nothing wires them into a timing backtest or the service ops.
modules.summary_es: Ajuste de modelos de series de tiempo: ARIMA, SARIMAX, VARMAX, AutoReg, ARDL, suavizamiento exponencial, STL, factor dinámico, componentes no observados, regresión y autorregresión con cambio de régimen de Markov, y VECM.

modules.summary: Fetches a symbol's history and computes RSI, MACD, Stochastic, CCI, ROC, Williams %R, Awesome Oscillator, TSI and Ultimate Oscillator.
modules.relevance_note: Produces indicator series only, with no trading-rule evaluation, so it says nothing about rule profitability net of costs.
modules.summary_es: Obtiene el historial de un símbolo y calcula RSI, MACD, Stochastic, CCI, ROC, Williams %R, Awesome Oscillator, TSI y Ultimate Oscillator.

modules.summary: TechnicalIndicators class with SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, Stochastic, Williams %R, ATR, CCI and ADX, plus calculate_all_indicators.
modules.relevance_note: Computes indicators only; it neither generates nor backtests signals. The only CLI command, 'test', runs on synthetic random-walk data.
modules.summary_es: Clase TechnicalIndicators con SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, Stochastic, Williams %R, ATR, CCI y ADX, además de calculate_all_indicators.

modules.summary: agent_definitions.json with 11 legendary-investor LLM personas, including rule-based screens such as Graham (P/E<=15, P/B<=1.5, current ratio>=2) and the Greenblatt Magic Formula (ROC and earnings-yield ranks, EV>$500M, excluding financials and utilities).
modules.relevance_note: Value and quality screens exist only as LLM instructions executed via yfinance/financial_datasets tools. The EV>$500M gate is the only microcap-style exclusion, and the LLM enforces it rather than code.
modules.summary_es: agent_definitions.json con 11 personajes LLM de inversionistas legendarios, incluidos filtros basados en reglas como el de Graham (P/E<=15, P/B<=1.5, razón circulante>=2) y la Magic Formula de Greenblatt (rankings de ROC y de rendimiento por utilidades, EV>$500M, excluyendo financieras y servicios públicos).

modules.summary: JSON configs for single-purpose LLM agents (news and narrative, behavioral finance, macro cycle, central bank, currency strategist, institutional flow tracker, Polymarket, RenTech) specifying model, instructions and tools.
modules.relevance_note: These configs define the LLM/news/sentiment and business-cycle 'signals': qualitative markdown outputs from GPT-class models with web, news and openbb tools. None of the agents' calls are logged or scored against subsequent returns.
modules.summary_es: Configuraciones JSON para agentes LLM de propósito único (noticias y narrativa, finanzas conductuales, ciclo macro, banco central, estratega de divisas, rastreador de flujos institucionales, Polymarket, RenTech) que especifican modelo, instrucciones y herramientas.

modules.summary: Paper-trading bridge (host or local) for portfolios, orders, fills, positions, trades and stats used by agents to execute simulated trades.
modules.relevance_note: Applies a flat 0.1% fee per fill (fee_rate 0.001) with no slippage or impact, so agent paper P&L is only lightly cost-adjusted. It is the only place agent decisions accrue realized outcomes.
modules.summary_es: Puente de paper trading (en el host o local) para portafolios, órdenes, ejecuciones, posiciones, operaciones y estadísticas, que usan los agentes para ejecutar operaciones simuladas.

modules.summary: ToolsRegistry catalog that lazily maps tool names (yfinance, financial_datasets, openbb, edgar, tavily, duckduckgo, newspaper, firecrawl, etc.) to Agno toolkit classes for agents.
modules.relevance_note: Defines which data sources feed the LLM agents: yfinance, OpenBB, SEC EDGAR and web/news scrapers. It has no dedicated Mexico (Banxico/INEGI/BMV) or options/short-interest tool.
modules.summary_es: Catálogo ToolsRegistry que asigna de forma diferida nombres de herramientas (yfinance, financial_datasets, openbb, edgar, tavily, duckduckgo, newspaper, firecrawl, etc.) a clases de toolkit de Agno para los agentes.

modules.summary: EdgarTools Agno toolkit wrapping the internal EDGAR MCP: 10-K/10-Q sections and full text, 8-K events, Form 4 insider transactions, 13F holdings, and XBRL financials and metrics.
modules.relevance_note: Supplies filing text for LLM text signals plus 13F institutional positioning and XBRL fundamentals usable for profitability screens. It is used qualitatively by the institutional_flow_tracker agent.
modules.summary_es: Toolkit de Agno EdgarTools que envuelve el MCP interno de EDGAR: secciones y texto completo de 10-K/10-Q, eventos 8-K, transacciones de insiders del Form 4, tenencias 13F, y estados financieros y métricas XBRL.

modules.summary: Agno toolkits for LLM agents (portfolio_tools, risk_tools, execution_tools, market_data_tools, compliance_tools) that mostly return placeholder dictionaries (e.g. fixed SMB/HML/UMD/QMJ exposures, fixed Kelly fractions, fixed optimal weights).
modules.relevance_note: These tools mention factor exposures, turnover and transaction-cost drag by name, but return mocked values. They should not be read as an implemented factor regression, optimizer or cost netting.
modules.summary_es: Toolkits de Agno para agentes LLM (portfolio_tools, risk_tools, execution_tools, market_data_tools, compliance_tools) que en su mayoría devuelven diccionarios de relleno (p. ej. exposiciones fijas a SMB/HML/UMD/QMJ, fracciones de Kelly fijas, ponderaciones óptimas fijas).

modules.summary: Agno toolkit exposed to LLM signal scientists (detect_patterns, backtest_signal, calculate_p_value, IC, regime dependency) where most methods return hard-coded illustrative numbers.
modules.relevance_note: backtest_signal returns a fixed Sharpe 2.1, net Sharpe 1.85 and '15% OOS degradation', and detect_patterns returns a fixed 'month_end_effect'. These are stubs, not computed evidence; only calculate_p_value does real math (a normal two-sided p from a test statistic), with no multiplicity correction.
modules.summary_es: Toolkit de Agno expuesto a científicos de señales LLM (detect_patterns, backtest_signal, calculate_p_value, IC, dependencia de régimen) en el que la mayoría de los métodos devuelven números ilustrativos fijos en el código.

modules.summary: SignalEvaluator scores realized signal outcomes by win rate (target 50.75%), average return, Spearman IC, p-value pass rate, timing and per-type breakdown.
modules.relevance_note: This is the closest thing to an ex-post decision-effectiveness evaluator in the agents area (hit rate, IC on realized outcomes). It averages raw p-values and has no deflation, bootstrap or multiple-testing control.
modules.summary_es: SignalEvaluator califica los resultados realizados de las señales por tasa de aciertos (meta de 50.75%), rendimiento promedio, IC de Spearman, tasa de aprobación por valor p, timing y desglose por tipo.

modules.summary: TradeEvaluator scores executed trades on execution quality, mean and volatility of reported slippage (bps), market impact (bps), fill quality and P&L by algorithm, against fixed targets and warning thresholds.
modules.relevance_note: Post-trade cost analysis that only averages per-trade slippage_bps and market_impact_bps supplied by the caller (targets of 2 and 5 bps). It does not estimate costs from turnover or net them from a strategy's return series.
modules.summary_es: TradeEvaluator califica las operaciones ejecutadas por calidad de ejecución, media y volatilidad del deslizamiento reportado (pb), impacto de mercado (pb), calidad de los fills y P&L por algoritmo, contra metas fijas y umbrales de advertencia.

modules.summary: Pre-trade guardrails that block signals on a p-value threshold, minimum sample size (100), confidence, data quality and staleness.
modules.relevance_note: Applies a single-test p threshold (risk_limits.min_p_value) per signal, with no Bonferroni/Holm/BHY haircut for the number of signals tried.
modules.summary_es: Salvaguardas previas a la operación que bloquean señales según un umbral de valor p, un tamaño mínimo de muestra (100), la confianza, la calidad de los datos y su antigüedad.

modules.summary: Static seed-knowledge text for the RenTech agent (strategy write-ups, a quarter-Kelly methodology, turnover targets); documents, not computing code.
modules.relevance_note: This links agent reasoning to literature on momentum and reversal, but as text for retrieval, not as replicated return series.
modules.summary_es: Texto estático de conocimiento semilla para el agente RenTech (descripciones de estrategias, una metodología de un cuarto de Kelly, metas de rotación). Son documentos, no código de cálculo.

modules.summary: Orchestrator RenaissanceTechnologiesSystem: fetches yfinance data, runs the signal, risk, execution and stat-arb analyses, and returns a MedallionDecision for one ticker or a portfolio, with an optional LLM-enhanced mode.
modules.relevance_note: Produces a point-in-time bullish/bearish/neutral decision with no historical replay, so its decision effectiveness cannot be measured inside this module.
modules.summary_es: Orquestador RenaissanceTechnologiesSystem: obtiene datos de yfinance, ejecuta los análisis de señales, riesgo, ejecución y arbitraje estadístico, y devuelve un MedallionDecision para un ticker o un portafolio, con un modo opcional mejorado con LLM.

modules.summary: InvestmentReasoner evaluates signals and sizes positions with discrete Kelly ((b*p-q)/b, with signal confidence as the win rate) scaled to quarter-Kelly, then applies liquidity, correlation and risk-limit adjustments.
modules.relevance_note: Fractional Kelly also lives here, besides quantstats, vbt_portfolio and polymarket_quant_bot. The win probability is the signal's confidence rather than an estimated hit rate, and the computed kelly_fraction variable is never used (a fixed 0.25 multiplier is applied).
modules.summary_es: InvestmentReasoner evalúa señales y dimensiona posiciones con Kelly discreto ((b*p-q)/b, usando la confianza de la señal como tasa de aciertos) escalado a un cuarto de Kelly, y luego aplica ajustes por liquidez, correlación y límites de riesgo.

modules.summary: Pure-quant pipeline that blends mean-reversion, momentum and autocorrelation into an aggregate signal, adds P/E-based value and ROE-based quality exposures, and synthesizes a Medallion decision with net edge, Kelly and leverage.
modules.relevance_note: synthesize_decision nets execution cost from the gross edge (net_edge = signal + arb edge - cost), but the reported 'p_value' is just 1 - a heuristic weighted score, not a statistical test. Value and quality are linear rescalings of P/E and ROE, and no backtest validates the weights (0.3/0.4/0.3 and 0.35/0.30/0.20/0.15).
modules.summary_es: Pipeline puramente cuantitativo que combina reversión a la media, momentum y autocorrelación en una señal agregada, añade exposiciones de valor basada en P/E y de calidad basada en ROE, y sintetiza una decisión Medallion con ventaja neta, Kelly y apalancamiento.

modules.summary: Transaction-cost model: square-root market impact, market-cap-tiered bid-ask spread, institutional/retail commission, participation- and urgency-scaled slippage, optimal trade size and implementation shortfall.
modules.relevance_note: This is the only explicit per-trade cost model in the agents area (50 bps spread for caps under $200M, sqrt impact with k=0.1). It prices a single trade but is never applied to a historical turnover series.
modules.summary_es: Modelo de costos de transacción: impacto de mercado de raíz cuadrada, spread bid-ask escalonado por capitalización de mercado, comisión institucional/minorista, deslizamiento escalado por participación y urgencia, tamaño óptimo de operación e implementation shortfall.

modules.summary: Mean-reversion diagnostics: z-score, AR(1)-style half-life, Hurst exponent, and a regression hedge-ratio pairs spread z-score.
modules.relevance_note: Implements the short-term reversal and pairs signals the agent draws on. analyze_pairs_cointegration uses an OLS hedge ratio and spread z-score, not a formal Engle-Granger or Johansen test, and it does no cost or out-of-sample evaluation.
modules.summary_es: Diagnósticos de reversión a la media: z-score, vida media estilo AR(1), exponente de Hurst y z-score del spread de pares con hedge ratio obtenido por regresión.

modules.summary: Single-ticker price momentum scoring with lookback returns, an R-squared trend-strength measure, acceleration, relative strength vs a benchmark, and a percentile rank against peer momentum values.
modules.relevance_note: Computes a gross time-series momentum signal per ticker rather than a WML long-short portfolio, and find_optimal_lookback picks the lookback in-sample by a Sharpe-like score, so the parameter is data-snooped with no out-of-sample check.
modules.summary_es: Puntuación de momentum de precio para un solo ticker con rendimientos de lookback, una medida de fuerza de tendencia basada en R cuadrada, aceleración, fuerza relativa frente a un benchmark y un rango percentil frente a valores de momentum de pares.

modules.summary: Risk toolkit: realized and EWMA (lambda 0.94) volatility, a vol-regime classifier, VaR, max drawdown, Sharpe/Sortino, beta, a single-factor risk decomposition, a capped Kelly fraction and position sizing.
modules.relevance_note: Kelly is capped at 25% (fractional Kelly) and volatility is RiskMetrics EWMA (the docstring says 'GARCH-like' but no GARCH is fitted). The factor decomposition is a one-factor market beta/R^2, not Fama-French, and the Sharpe ratio is plain, with no PSR/DSR adjustment.
modules.summary_es: Kit de riesgo: volatilidad realizada y EWMA (lambda 0.94), un clasificador de régimen de volatilidad, VaR, drawdown máximo, Sharpe/Sortino, beta, una descomposición del riesgo de un solo factor, una fracción de Kelly acotada y dimensionamiento de posiciones.

modules.summary: Classifies the market regime (bull/bear/sideways/transition) from 60-day annualized return and volatility thresholds, and scores statistical mispricing, pairs trades and edge in bps.
modules.relevance_note: Its regime detection is described as 'inspired by Hidden Markov Models' but is a fixed-threshold rule (no HMM or Markov-switching estimation), and estimate_edge yields a gross edge that is only netted against costs later in analysis.py.
modules.summary_es: Clasifica el régimen de mercado (alcista/bajista/lateral/transición) a partir de umbrales de rendimiento y volatilidad anualizados a 60 días, y califica el mispricing estadístico, las operaciones de pares y la ventaja en pb.

modules.summary: Fetches prices, market cap, ADV, revenues, earnings and ratio metrics from yfinance for a ticker, uses SPY as the market benchmark, and validates and prepares the analysis inputs.
