modules.relevance_note: This is the only data feed for the RenTech agent: yfinance with a SPY benchmark, so beta is computed against the US market even for non-US tickers such as .MX listings, and there is no survivorship-free or point-in-time fundamentals source.
modules.summary_es: Obtiene de yfinance precios, capitalización de mercado, ADV, ingresos, utilidades y métricas de razones para un ticker, usa SPY como benchmark de mercado, y valida y prepara los insumos del análisis.

modules.summary: Multi-step LLM workflow in which quant researcher, risk and IC agents are prompted to validate a discovered signal (statistical analysis, regime robustness, approval).
modules.relevance_note: Bonferroni correction, FDR, bootstrap and purged cross-validation are only requested in the LLM prompt text and never computed in code, so their results depend on LLM output, not on statistics.
modules.summary_es: Flujo de trabajo LLM de varios pasos en el que se instruye a agentes de investigador cuantitativo, de riesgo y de IC para validar una señal descubierta (análisis estadístico, robustez ante regímenes, aprobación).

modules.summary: JSON CLI used by AIQuantLabService.cpp to start and monitor RD-Agent factor mining, model optimization (LightGBM, XGBoost, LSTM, GRU, Transformer, TCN) and quant research tasks, and to export factors.
modules.relevance_note: This is the entry point for ML cross-sectional prediction and alpha mining. Reported metrics (IC, ICIR, Sharpe, annualized return, MDD) are in-loop backtest numbers with no deflation for the number of iterations.
modules.summary_es: CLI JSON que usa AIQuantLabService.cpp para iniciar y monitorear la minería de factores de RD-Agent, la optimización de modelos (LightGBM, XGBoost, LSTM, GRU, Transformer, TCN) y tareas de investigación cuantitativa, y para exportar factores.

modules.summary: Builds Microsoft RD-Agent loops (FactorRDLoop, ModelRDLoop, QuantRDLoop, FactorReportLoop) on Qlib for autonomous LLM-driven factor and model discovery, with a target IC, checkpoints and extracted factor/model results.
modules.relevance_note: Implements iterative propose-code-run-feedback factor mining with IC/ICIR/Sharpe feedback, which is exactly the many-trials setting where DSR and PBO matter. No trial counting or multiple-testing haircut is applied to discovered factors.
modules.summary_es: Construye loops de Microsoft RD-Agent (FactorRDLoop, ModelRDLoop, QuantRDLoop, FactorReportLoop) sobre Qlib para el descubrimiento autónomo de factores y modelos impulsado por LLM, con un IC objetivo, checkpoints y resultados extraídos de factores/modelos.

modules.summary: Backtest module with market microstructure (OrderBook, MarketImpactModel, SlippageModel, TWAP/VWAP/IS/POV execution) and a run_backtest that holds the top-K stocks by trailing 20-day yfinance momentum.
modules.relevance_note: It produces a GROSS equal-weight momentum backtest (signal lagged one day) and reports a separate cost estimate for one sample order that is never subtracted. Sharpe is ann_ret/ann_vol with no risk-free rate, and optimize_portfolio is a not-implemented placeholder.
modules.summary_es: Módulo de backtest con microestructura de mercado (OrderBook, MarketImpactModel, SlippageModel, ejecución TWAP/VWAP/IS/POV) y un run_backtest que mantiene las top-K acciones según el momentum de los últimos 20 días obtenido de yfinance.

modules.summary: Manager for time-series deep learning models (PyTorch SimpleLSTM/GRU/Transformer and Qlib LSTM_TS/GRU_TS), with create, train and predict and saved state.
modules.relevance_note: These are the kind of deep-learning return predictors studied in the ML asset-pricing literature, but they are judged by fit only, with no economic evaluation after costs.
modules.summary_es: Administrador de modelos de deep learning para series de tiempo (SimpleLSTM/GRU/Transformer en PyTorch y LSTM_TS/GRU_TS de Qlib), con creación, entrenamiento, predicción y estado guardado.

modules.summary: Qlib-style preprocessing pipeline: MinMax, ZScore, RobustZScore, cross-sectional z-score and rank normalisation, winsorize, fillna and inf handling, with saved pipeline configs.
modules.relevance_note: Provides the cross-sectional rank and z-score normalisation that ML return-prediction studies apply to stock characteristics. It has a fit/transform split, but whether data leaks across time depends on the caller.
modules.summary_es: Pipeline de preprocesamiento al estilo Qlib: MinMax, ZScore, RobustZScore, z-score transversal y normalización por rango, winsorización, manejo de fillna y de valores inf, con configuraciones de pipeline guardadas.

modules.summary: Factor and signal evaluation: Pearson and rank IC, IC t-test, quantile returns and monotonicity, turnover of the top-N, VaR/CVaR risk metrics, factor combination and a graded report.
modules.relevance_note: IC significance is a single one-sample t-test at alpha=0.05, with no Bonferroni/Holm/BHY correction and no t>3 hurdle. Turnover is measured but never turned into a cost drag.
modules.summary_es: Evaluación de factores y señales: IC de Pearson y de rango, prueba t del IC, rendimientos por cuantil y monotonicidad, rotación del top-N, métricas de riesgo VaR/CVaR, combinación de factores y un reporte con calificación.

modules.summary: Feature library (MA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, ATR, stochastic, momentum, volatility, OBV, VWAP, rolling beta, drawdown), a sandboxed Qlib-style formulaic-alpha expression engine and IC-based feature selection.
modules.relevance_note: select_features_by_ic keeps the top-k features by in-sample |IC|, a data-mining step with no out-of-sample check or multiple-testing control. rolling_beta is a building block for betting-against-beta, but no BAB portfolio is built.
modules.summary_es: Biblioteca de features (MA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, ATR, estocástico, momentum, volatilidad, OBV, VWAP, beta móvil, drawdown), un motor aislado (sandbox) de expresiones de alfas formulaicos al estilo Qlib y selección de features basada en IC.

modules.summary: Live CCXT order-book analytics: book metrics, market-making quotes, toxic-flow detection and a slippage estimate from walking the order book.
modules.relevance_note: Measures realistic execution cost on crypto venues (slippage vs mid from walking the book), which could feed cost netting, but it is not connected to any backtest.
modules.summary_es: Analítica en vivo del libro de órdenes vía CCXT: métricas del libro, cotizaciones de market making, detección de flujo tóxico y una estimación de slippage recorriendo el libro de órdenes.

modules.summary: Model selection, ensembles and hyperparameter tuning across sklearn and boosting models. When no data is supplied it falls back to random synthetic data.
modules.relevance_note: Picks the best of many models and hyperparameter trials on a single holdout without correcting for the number of trials, which is classic selection bias.
modules.summary_es: Selección de modelos, ensambles y ajuste de hiperparámetros con modelos de sklearn y de boosting. Si no se proporcionan datos, recurre a datos sintéticos aleatorios.

modules.summary: Incremental learning with River (linear, Hoeffding/adaptive trees, adaptive random forest, bagging, EWA, SRP), rolling-update scheduling and a concept-drift handler.
modules.relevance_note: Handles changing markets only in name: handle_concept_drift either resets the model or just returns a message ('adaptive'). There is no drift detector and no regime model.
modules.summary_es: Aprendizaje incremental con River (lineal, árboles Hoeffding/adaptativos, random forest adaptativo, bagging, EWA, SRP), programación de actualizaciones móviles y un manejador de concept drift.

modules.summary: Portfolio optimisers built on scipy: Black-Litterman, Hierarchical Risk Parity, minimum variance, maximum Sharpe and efficient frontier.
modules.relevance_note: Covers Markowitz, Black-Litterman and HRP from the literature, but uses the sample covariance with no Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage and no comparison against a 1/N benchmark.
modules.summary_es: Optimizadores de portafolio construidos sobre scipy: Black-Litterman, Hierarchical Risk Parity, mínima varianza, máximo Sharpe y frontera eficiente.

modules.summary: Reporting on flat arrays: IC and rank-IC analysis with verdicts, cumulative returns vs a benchmark, a drawdown/VaR/CVaR/rolling-vol risk report, model performance, and factor quantile spreads and monotonicity.
modules.relevance_note: Labels signals with rule-of-thumb verdicts on raw IC (ICIR>=0.75 is 'STRONG') without any significance or multiple-testing correction.
modules.summary_es: Reportes sobre arreglos planos: análisis de IC e IC de rango con veredictos, rendimientos acumulados contra un benchmark, un reporte de riesgo con drawdown/VaR/CVaR/volatilidad móvil, desempeño del modelo, y spreads y monotonicidad por cuantil de factores.

modules.summary: Gym trading environment and stable-baselines RL agents (PPO, DQN, A2C, SAC, TD3) on yfinance OHLCV, with a proportional commission.
modules.relevance_note: Charges a proportional commission (default 10bp) inside the reward, but runs on a single asset and evaluates with episodes that have no separate out-of-sample period.
modules.summary_es: Entorno de trading de Gym y agentes de RL de stable-baselines (PPO, DQN, A2C, SAC, TD3) sobre OHLCV de yfinance, con una comisión proporcional.

modules.summary: Walk-forward retraining scheduler built on Qlib Rolling, with a built-in LightGBM + Alpha158 template and step/horizon windows, streaming progress for each window.
modules.relevance_note: The closest thing in the area to walk-forward out-of-sample validation (rolling step=20, horizon=20), but it has no purging or embargo and does not estimate the probability of backtest overfitting.
modules.summary_es: Programador de reentrenamiento walk-forward construido sobre Qlib Rolling, con una plantilla integrada LightGBM + Alpha158 y ventanas de step/horizon, que transmite el progreso de cada ventana.

modules.summary: Wraps Microsoft Qlib: Alpha158/Alpha360 data handlers, about 15 Qlib ML models (LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost, linear, LSTM, GRU, ALSTM, Transformer, TCN, ADARNN, HIST, TabNet, SFM), plus training, prediction, a TopkDropout daily backtest and factor IC analysis.
modules.relevance_note: This is the only engine in the area that subtracts costs from returns (net = return - cost; 5bp to open, 15bp to close, min 5, 9.5% limit). But train_model sets the test segment equal to the validation segment, and get_factor_analysis ranks the top-N Alpha158 factors by |IC| without any multiple-testing adjustment.
modules.summary_es: Envuelve Microsoft Qlib: data handlers Alpha158/Alpha360, unos 15 modelos de ML de Qlib (LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost, lineal, LSTM, GRU, ALSTM, Transformer, TCN, ADARNN, HIST, TabNet, SFM), además de entrenamiento, predicción, un backtest diario TopkDropout y análisis de IC de factores.

modules.summary: Builds strategy configs: TopK-dropout, enhanced indexing, weight-based, risk parity (equal risk contribution) and mean-variance, and computes portfolio metrics.
modules.relevance_note: Implements risk-parity and Markowitz weights for ML score portfolios, but calculate_portfolio_metrics is gross: no turnover or cost terms.
modules.summary_es: Construye configuraciones de estrategia: TopK-dropout, indexación mejorada, basada en pesos, paridad de riesgo (contribución de riesgo igual) y media-varianza, y calcula métricas del portafolio.

modules.summary: ExpandedFundsWrapper for Chinese mutual funds and ETFs: overview, fees, NAV histories, ETF history and fund ratings (Shanghai, Zhishu, JiAn).
modules.relevance_note: Supplies NAV and fee data from which active-fund vs index (SPIVA-like) comparisons could be computed. No such persistence or survivorship analysis exists in this area.
modules.summary_es: ExpandedFundsWrapper para fondos de inversión y ETFs chinos: panorama general, comisiones, historiales de NAV, historial de ETFs y calificaciones de fondos (Shanghai, Zhishu, JiAn).

modules.summary: AKShare index wrapper including China option volatility indices (50ETF, 300ETF and 500ETF QVIX) and other index series.
modules.relevance_note: Provides non-US implied-volatility fear gauges analogous to VIX, as data only.
modules.summary_es: Wrapper de índices de AKShare que incluye índices de volatilidad de opciones de China (QVIX de 50ETF, 300ETF y 500ETF) y otras series de índices.

modules.summary: MiscWrapper over AKShare miscellany including article_epu_index (Economic Policy Uncertainty), article_ff_crr (Fama-French CRR factors) and Oxford-Man/RLab realized volatility series.
modules.relevance_note: The only Fama-French factor download found in this area (via AKShare), plus realized-vol and EPU series. Nothing in the agents area runs factor regressions or alpha t-stats with them.
modules.summary_es: MiscWrapper sobre datos misceláneos de AKShare, incluidos article_epu_index (Economic Policy Uncertainty), article_ff_crr (factores CRR de Fama-French) y series de volatilidad realizada de Oxford-Man/RLab.

modules.summary: AKShare wrapper for SSE/SZSE margin financing and securities-lending balances and details, margin account info, and HSGT (Stock Connect) northbound flow histories, rankings and holdings.
modules.relevance_note: Gives China leverage and short-selling balances and foreign-flow series (retail/margin sentiment proxies). The data is fetched but never tested as a predictor.
modules.summary_es: Wrapper de AKShare para saldos y detalles de financiamiento con margen y préstamo de valores en SSE/SZSE, información de cuentas de margen, e historiales, rankings y tenencias de los flujos northbound de HSGT (Stock Connect).

modules.summary: BCBWrapper for the Banco Central do Brasil SGS API: Selic, IPCA, IGP-M, USD/BRL and EUR/BRL PTAX, monetary aggregates, GDP, unemployment, credit and reserves.
modules.relevance_note: This is the only dedicated LatAm central-bank feed (Brazil). No equivalent Banxico or INEGI wrapper exists for Mexico.
modules.summary_es: BCBWrapper para la API SGS del Banco Central do Brasil: Selic, IPCA, IGP-M, PTAX USD/BRL y EUR/BRL, agregados monetarios, PIB, desempleo, crédito y reservas.

modules.summary: CBOEDataAPI for equity and index quotes and history, index constituents, VX futures curve and full options chains.
modules.relevance_note: Supplies options chains and the VX futures curve, the raw inputs for put/call, skew and term-structure sentiment measures that are not computed here.
modules.summary_es: CBOEDataAPI para cotizaciones e históricos de acciones e índices, componentes de índices, curva de futuros VX y cadenas de opciones completas.

modules.summary: Downloads CBOE index histories (VIX, VIX3M, VVIX, SKEW, VXN, GVZ, OVX, etc.) from the CBOE CDN and builds a VIX term-structure snapshot.
modules.relevance_note: Primary source of implied-volatility and fear-gauge series. It does not compute a variance risk premium (VIX minus realized vol) or VIX-based timing signals.
modules.summary_es: Descarga históricos de índices de CBOE (VIX, VIX3M, VVIX, SKEW, VXN, GVZ, OVX, etc.) desde el CDN de CBOE y arma una instantánea de la estructura temporal del VIX.

modules.summary: CFTCDataWrapper for Commitments of Traders reports (legacy/disaggregated, including VIX futures) with a positioning-based market sentiment analysis and historical trend.
modules.relevance_note: Provides speculator vs commercial positioning in futures as a sentiment/positioning predictor. analyze_market_sentiment is descriptive (long % of OI), with no return test.
modules.summary_es: CFTCDataWrapper para los reportes Commitments of Traders (legacy/desagregados, incluidos los futuros del VIX) con un análisis de sentimiento de mercado basado en el posicionamiento y la tendencia histórica.

modules.summary: Computes trend, momentum, volatility and volume technical indicators on OHLCV JSON using the scripts/technicals package.
modules.relevance_note: Produces indicator values only (MA, RSI, etc.), with no trading-rule backtest, cost netting or data-snooping control over the indicator set.
modules.summary_es: Calcula indicadores técnicos de tendencia, momentum, volatilidad y volumen sobre JSON de OHLCV usando el paquete scripts/technicals.

modules.summary: FederalReserveWrapper CLI for Federal Reserve and NY Fed data: fed funds, SOFR, OBFR, Treasury rates, the H.15 yield curve, money measures and SOMA holdings.
modules.relevance_note: Supplies the term-structure inputs for yield-curve recession and timing signals, but no module turns them into a term-spread predictor or a regime state.
modules.summary_es: CLI FederalReserveWrapper para datos de la Reserva Federal y de la Fed de Nueva York: fed funds, SOFR, OBFR, tasas del Tesoro, la curva de rendimiento H.15, medidas monetarias y tenencias SOMA.

modules.summary: Finnhub wrapper for quotes, company profile, financial statements, earnings calendar, company news, FX and crypto candles.
modules.relevance_note: Feeds company news text and earnings-announcement dates (an event-calendar input), but computes no signal itself.
modules.summary_es: Wrapper de Finnhub para cotizaciones, perfil de la empresa, estados financieros, calendario de reportes de resultados, noticias de la empresa y velas de FX y cripto.

modules.summary: Generic FRED API client for any series, search, categories, release dates and multi-series downloads.
modules.relevance_note: Can pull any Goyal-Welch-style predictor available on FRED (and FRED's Mexico series by ID), but holds no predictor set or timing model.
modules.summary_es: Cliente genérico de la API de FRED para cualquier serie, búsqueda, categorías, fechas de publicación y descargas de múltiples series.

modules.summary: Extended FRED fetcher for Treasury yield curve and 10y-2y and 10y-3m spreads, money supply, credit conditions, financial stress indices (STLFSI, NFCI, VIXCLS, MOVE, TED), consumer sentiment (UMich, Conference Board) and PCE inflation.
modules.relevance_note: Main source of classic macro predictors (term spread, credit, stress, sentiment) used in equity-premium and recession studies. It only fetches them and has no predictive regression or out-of-sample R^2.
modules.summary_es: Descargador extendido de FRED para la curva de rendimiento del Tesoro y los spreads 10y-2y y 10y-3m, oferta monetaria, condiciones de crédito, índices de estrés financiero (STLFSI, NFCI, VIXCLS, MOVE, TED), confianza del consumidor (UMich, Conference Board) e inflación PCE.

modules.summary: Inter-American Development Bank client for LatAm and Caribbean projects, country indicators, disbursements, sectors and countries.
modules.relevance_note: Provides development and economic indicators for Mexico and LatAm, but no market (equity index, rates curve) data.
modules.summary_es: Cliente del Banco Interamericano de Desarrollo para proyectos de América Latina y el Caribe, indicadores por país, desembolsos, sectores y países.

modules.summary: Investing.com calendars (economic, earnings, IPO, dividend, splits, bonds) with a Trading Economics fallback.
modules.relevance_note: Provides event dates (macro releases such as FOMC, earnings) needed for event and calendar studies, but no day-of-week, turn-of-month or pre-FOMC return analysis is implemented.
modules.summary_es: Calendarios de Investing.com (económico, de resultados, de IPO, de dividendos, de splits y de bonos) con Trading Economics como respaldo.

modules.summary: MULTPLDataFetcher scraping multpl.com S&P 500 series: Shiller CAPE, P/E, dividend yield, earnings yield, P/B, P/S, earnings and dividend growth, real prices.
modules.relevance_note: Supplies the CAPE and dividend-yield predictors central to market-timing literature. It is scraped (not vintage or point-in-time) and is US-only.
modules.summary_es: MULTPLDataFetcher que extrae por scraping series del S&P 500 de multpl.com: CAPE de Shiller, P/E, rendimiento por dividendo, rendimiento de utilidades, P/B, P/S, crecimiento de utilidades y de dividendos, y precios reales.

modules.summary: NBER business-cycle peak/trough table since 1857, a monthly recession indicator, macrohistory, CPS and unemployment data.
modules.relevance_note: Provides hard-coded US recession labels usable as ground truth for regime and recession models. It contains no model, and its labels are revised ex post (look-ahead risk if used as a predictor).
modules.summary_es: Tabla de picos y valles del ciclo económico del NBER desde 1857, un indicador mensual de recesión, y datos de macrohistoria, de la CPS y de desempleo.

modules.summary: News correlation engine detecting velocity spikes, keyword spikes, triangulation, geo-convergence and news-leads-markets signals, plus a Country Instability Index and baseline deviation tracking.
modules.relevance_note: Generates news-event signals from count thresholds (e.g. 3x volume, 5+ mentions), with no statistical test of whether they predict returns.
modules.summary_es: Motor de correlación de noticias que detecta picos de velocidad, picos de palabras clave, triangulación, convergencia geográfica y señales de noticias que se adelantan a los mercados, además de un Country Instability Index y seguimiento de desviaciones respecto a la línea base.

modules.summary: News NLP pipeline: country and ticker entity extraction, TF-IDF cosine semantic clustering of headlines, and batch sentiment with finance-tuned VADER or a keyword-lexicon fallback that labels BULLISH/BEARISH/NEUTRAL.
modules.relevance_note: This is the main text-sentiment signal generator: a dictionary/VADER method, not an LLM or FinBERT. Labels use fixed +/-0.15 thresholds with no link to subsequent returns.
modules.summary_es: Pipeline de NLP de noticias: extracción de entidades de país y ticker, agrupamiento semántico de titulares por similitud coseno con TF-IDF, y sentimiento por lotes con VADER ajustado a finanzas o un léxico de palabras clave como respaldo, que etiqueta BULLISH/BEARISH/NEUTRAL.

modules.summary: OECDWrapper (SDMX v1/v2) for real GDP, CPI, GDP forecasts, unemployment, interest rates and trade balance by country, with 'mexico' mapped to MEX.
modules.relevance_note: One of the few paths to Mexico macro series (via a country-code map, as also in imf_data.py and econdb_data.py), usable as macro predictors. It provides no Mexico-specific analytics.
modules.summary_es: OECDWrapper (SDMX v1/v2) para PIB real, CPI, pronósticos de PIB, desempleo, tasas de interés y balanza comercial por país, con 'mexico' mapeado a MEX.

modules.summary: SciPy portfolio optimizer over yfinance returns supporting max_sharpe, min_volatility, risk_parity, equal_weight (1/N), hrp, target_return and black_litterman, plus a 40-point efficient frontier and an all-methods comparison.
modules.relevance_note: Uses sample mean and covariance with no shrinkage. 'hrp' is an inverse-variance proxy rather than true hierarchical clustering, BL uses an equal-weight prior, and there is no out-of-sample or turnover/cost comparison against 1/N.
modules.summary_es: Optimizador de portafolio con SciPy sobre rendimientos de yfinance que soporta max_sharpe, min_volatility, risk_parity, equal_weight (1/N), hrp, target_return y black_litterman, además de una frontera eficiente de 40 puntos y una comparación de todos los métodos.

modules.summary: Standalone Polymarket paper-trading bot: a particle-filter and Monte Carlo probability estimate, edge detection vs market price, half-Kelly sizing, a Brier-score tracker and a risk manager.
modules.relevance_note: The clearest Kelly implementation (half-Kelly) and the only module that scores its probability forecasts with a proper score (Brier), a template for measuring decision effectiveness.
modules.summary_es: Bot independiente de paper trading para Polymarket: una estimación de probabilidad con filtro de partículas y Monte Carlo, detección de ventaja (edge) frente al precio de mercado, dimensionamiento con medio Kelly, un rastreador del Brier score y un gestor de riesgo.

modules.summary: Computes portfolio performance stats (annual return and vol, Sharpe and Sortino at a fixed 4% rf, Calmar, max drawdown, 95% VaR/CVaR) from yfinance prices and given weights.
modules.relevance_note: Reports a raw gross Sharpe with no PSR/DSR, no autocorrelation adjustment and no cost netting. Deflated Sharpe exists only elsewhere (Analytics/backtesting/vectorbt/vbt_returns.py).
modules.summary_es: Calcula estadísticas de desempeño del portafolio (rendimiento y volatilidad anuales, Sharpe y Sortino con una rf fija de 4%, Calmar, drawdown máximo, VaR/CVaR al 95%) a partir de precios de yfinance y pesos dados.

modules.summary: Fits GBM to two years of portfolio daily returns and simulates 1-year paths, reporting median, 5th and 95th percentile returns, probability of loss and expected max drawdown.
modules.relevance_note: Wealth Monte Carlo under i.i.d. normal (GBM) returns estimated from a short 2-year window, which understates fat tails and parameter uncertainty for long-horizon risk.
modules.summary_es: Ajusta un GBM a dos años de rendimientos diarios del portafolio y simula trayectorias a 1 año, y reporta la mediana y los percentiles 5 y 95 de los rendimientos, la probabilidad de pérdida y el drawdown máximo esperado.

modules.summary: Fetches a corporate-intelligence bundle for one ticker from yfinance: governance, holders, peers, earnings calendar, technicals, enterprise multiples and short interest (sharesShort, shortRatio, shortPercentOfFloat).
modules.relevance_note: The only short-interest source found: a current yfinance snapshot, with no historical short-interest series (no FINRA feed) that could support a short-interest anomaly test.
modules.summary_es: Obtiene de yfinance un paquete de inteligencia corporativa para un ticker: gobierno corporativo, tenedores, pares, calendario de resultados, indicadores técnicos, múltiplos de valor empresa e interés en corto (sharesShort, shortRatio, shortPercentOfFloat).

modules.summary: HistoricalReturnsAlphaModel plus Black-Litterman portfolio construction with UnconstrainedMeanVariancePortfolioOptimizer (MeanVarianceOptimizationFrameworkAlgorithm and RiskParityPortfolioAlgorithm are similar).
modules.relevance_note: In fincept_engine the Black-Litterman, mean-variance and risk-parity models are stubs (1/N or no-op), so these strategies do not perform the optimisation their names describe.
modules.summary_es: HistoricalReturnsAlphaModel más construcción de portafolio Black-Litterman con UnconstrainedMeanVariancePortfolioOptimizer (MeanVarianceOptimizationFrameworkAlgorithm y RiskParityPortfolioAlgorithm son similares).

modules.summary: Each month picks the two Dow 30 stocks with the highest OLS intercept from a regression against SPY.
modules.relevance_note: Ranks raw in-sample CAPM alphas with no t-statistics, and the regression is inverted (benchmark regressed on the stock). It works through a universe-selection model that the engine never runs.
modules.summary_es: Cada mes elige las dos acciones del Dow 30 con el intercepto OLS más alto de una regresión contra SPY.

modules.summary: Coarse filter keeps the top-N stocks by dollar volume; fine filter sorts by P/E descending and holds the top names.
modules.relevance_note: Sorts for the highest P/E, a growth tilt that is the opposite of value (HML). Fundamentals in fincept_engine default to 0, so the selection means nothing there.
modules.summary_es: El filtro grueso conserva las top-N acciones por volumen en dólares; el filtro fino ordena por P/E de forma descendente y mantiene los primeros nombres.

modules.summary: Demonstrates custom fill, fee (1bp, minimum $1), slippage (log of quantity) and buying-power models.
modules.relevance_note: Shows the intended cost hooks, but fincept_engine.market_order never calls get_order_fee or get_slippage_approximation (VolumeShareSlippageModelAlgorithm has the same problem).
modules.summary_es: Muestra modelos personalizados de ejecución (fill), comisión (1 pb, mínimo $1), slippage (logaritmo de la cantidad) y poder de compra.

modules.summary: Custom volatility model: annualised standard deviation over a rolling window, attached to a security.
modules.relevance_note: The only volatility estimator among the strategies: simple historical volatility, no GARCH, and no exposure scaled to a volatility target.
modules.summary_es: Modelo de volatilidad personalizado: desviación estándar anualizada sobre una ventana móvil, asociado a un instrumento.

modules.summary: Monthly rotation into the best of MDY, IEV, EEM, ILF, EPP, EDV and SHY by weighted 1- and 3-month momentum; holds cash when the best score is 0 or below.
modules.relevance_note: A dual-momentum (relative plus absolute) rotation in which ILF (Latin America 40) is the only Latin American exposure. No skip-month and no costs.
modules.summary_es: Rotación mensual hacia el mejor de MDY, IEV, EEM, ILF, EPP, EDV y SHY según el momentum ponderado de 1 y 3 meses; se queda en efectivo cuando la mejor puntuación es 0 o menor.

modules.summary: Uses an EMA crossover on SPY to go long or short the front-month S&P 500 E-mini future.
modules.relevance_note: Trend following on a single market, not diversified multi-asset time-series momentum (Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen), and with no volatility scaling.
modules.summary_es: Usa un cruce de EMA sobre SPY para ir largo o corto en el futuro E-mini del S&P 500 del mes más cercano.

modules.summary: Trains a Keras network on 30 days of opening prices to predict the next open and trades on the prediction (PytorchNeuralNetworkAlgorithm and TensorFlowNeuralNetworkAlgorithm are similar).
modules.relevance_note: A neural net on price levels of a few symbols. Under fincept_engine, history() returns a synthetic ramp, so the trained model proves nothing.
modules.summary_es: Entrena una red de Keras con 30 días de precios de apertura para predecir la siguiente apertura y opera según la predicción (PytorchNeuralNetworkAlgorithm y TensorFlowNeuralNetworkAlgorithm son similares).

modules.summary: Classic 15/30-day EMA crossover on SPY, long or flat, with a small tolerance band (MACDTrendAlgorithm and DisplacedMovingAverageRibbon are similar).
modules.relevance_note: One of the few strategies that trade through on_data and so actually trade in the fincept runner. It fills at the close of the signal bar with zero fees.
modules.summary_es: Cruce clásico de EMA de 15/30 días sobre SPY, en largo o fuera del mercado, con una pequeña banda de tolerancia (MACDTrendAlgorithm y DisplacedMovingAverageRibbon son similares).

modules.summary: Downloads a CSV of economic-news headlines, tokenises it with NLTK, and buys or liquidates SPY depending on whether 'Up' or 'Down' appears.
modules.relevance_note: A toy keyword-sentiment rule: no LLM, no finance word list (such as Loughran-McDonald) and no out-of-sample evaluation.
modules.summary_es: Descarga un CSV de titulares de noticias económicas, lo tokeniza con NLTK y compra o liquida SPY según aparezca 'Up' o 'Down'.

modules.summary: Auto-generated index of 418 strategies keyed by FCT ids: 86 options, 80 regression tests, 64 general, 30 universe selection, 25 alpha models and others.
modules.relevance_note: A large menu of mostly ported QuantConnect demo and regression algorithms. Picking the best one by backtest invites selection bias, and no count of trials is kept.
modules.summary_es: Índice autogenerado de 418 estrategias identificadas por ids FCT: 86 de opciones, 80 pruebas de regresión, 64 generales, 30 de selección de universo, 25 modelos alfa y otras.

modules.summary: 14 ports of QuantConnect's Benchmark Alpha Series: Greenblatt, Merton default, IBS, lunch-break reversion, intraday FX reversal, gas-crude, mortgage-rate volatility, price gap, leveraged-ETF rebalancing and decay, share class, Sykes microcap, triangle FX arbitrage and VIX dual thrust.
modules.relevance_note: 13 of 14 explicitly set ConstantFeeModel(0), and all depend on AlphaModels that the fincept engine never runs, so as run here they produce no evidence.
modules.summary_es: 14 adaptaciones de la Benchmark Alpha Series de QuantConnect: Greenblatt, default de Merton, IBS, reversión en la hora de la comida, reversión intradía de FX, gas-crudo, volatilidad de la tasa hipotecaria, gap de precio, rebalanceo y decaimiento de ETFs apalancados, clase de acciones, microcaps de Sykes, arbitraje triangular de FX y dual thrust sobre el VIX.

modules.summary: Computes a Merton contingent-claims probability of default, N(-d2), from fundamentals and emits 'down' insights for likely defaulters.
modules.relevance_note: A distress-risk signal related to the 'safety' leg of QMJ. The comment says it takes the smallest 750 names, but the code takes the top 750 by dollar volume. The default threshold is arbitrary and fees are zero.
modules.summary_es: Calcula una probabilidad de incumplimiento de Merton por derechos contingentes, N(-d2), a partir de fundamentales y emite insights 'down' para los probables incumplidores.

modules.summary: Ranks about 32 country and region equity ETFs by the previous day's Internal Bar Strength: long the lowest, short the highest.
modules.relevance_note: Includes Latin American ETFs (ECH, EWZ, GXG, ILF) but not the Mexico ETF EWW; EWM is listed three times, likely in its place. So there is no Mexico-specific exposure. A daily reversal strategy run with zero fees.
modules.summary_es: Clasifica unos 32 ETFs de acciones de países y regiones por el Internal Bar Strength del día anterior: largo en el más bajo y corto en el más alto.

modules.summary: Monthly universe in the style of QC500 (US, NYSE/NASDAQ, listed over 180 days, market cap over $500M) ranked by EV/EBITDA and then forward ROA.
modules.relevance_note: The area's only combined value and profitability screen and its only size filter (>$500M). But it sorts EV/EBITDA descending and ROA ascending, which picks expensive, low-ROA stocks, the opposite of the Magic Formula. It also uses zero fees, and fundamentals in fincept_engine are zero placeholders.
modules.summary_es: Universo mensual al estilo QC500 (EE. UU., NYSE/NASDAQ, más de 180 días listado, capitalización de mercado mayor a $500M) clasificado por EV/EBITDA y luego por ROA prospectivo.

modules.summary: Ranks 20 ETFs by their return from the previous close to noon and predicts mean reversion over the lunch break.
modules.relevance_note: Captures intraday time-of-day seasonality only. The area has no day-of-week, turn-of-month or FOMC tests.
modules.summary_es: Clasifica 20 ETFs por su rendimiento desde el cierre anterior hasta el mediodía y predice reversión a la media durante la hora de la comida.

modules.summary: Uses deviations and volatility of the Quandl 30-year mortgage rate to time real-estate ETFs.
modules.relevance_note: The area's only market-timing rule driven by a macro variable. It has no out-of-sample R² test against the historical mean (Welch-Goyal).
modules.summary_es: Usa las desviaciones y la volatilidad de la tasa hipotecaria a 30 años de Quandl para hacer timing de ETFs inmobiliarios.

modules.summary: Each month, shorts the 10 biggest one-day gainers among sub-$5 penny stocks with daily volume between 10k and 1M.
modules.relevance_note: Deliberately trades microcaps with zero fees and no borrow cost. That is exactly the setup in which published anomalies disappear once costs are subtracted and microcaps excluded.
modules.summary_es: Cada mes vende en corto las 10 acciones con mayor alza en un día entre las penny stocks de menos de $5 con volumen diario de entre 10k y 1M.

modules.summary: Dual-thrust range-breakout alpha trading UVXY (a VIX-futures product) on consolidated bars, with k1=k2=0.63 and a 20-bar range.
modules.relevance_note: A comment in the source says the parameters were chosen because they 'gave acceptable results on a series of random backtests'. That is textbook data snooping, and no haircut is applied.
modules.summary_es: Alfa de ruptura de rango dual-thrust que opera UVXY (un producto de futuros del VIX) sobre barras consolidadas, con k1=k2=0.63 y un rango de 20 barras.

modules.summary: QCAlgorithm shim compatible with QuantConnect LEAN (orders, holdings, history, scheduling), plus stub framework models (ConstantAlpha, EqualWeighting, MeanVariance/Black-Litterman portfolio construction, execution and drawdown risk models).
modules.relevance_note: Orders fill instantly at the current bar price with zero fee; fee and slippage models are stored but never used. history() returns a synthetic linear price ramp, MVO and Black-Litterman models return 1/N weights, and models passed to set_alpha or set_portfolio_construction are never run (emit_insights does nothing).
modules.summary_es: Shim de QCAlgorithm compatible con QuantConnect LEAN (órdenes, posiciones, historial, programación), además de modelos stub del framework (ConstantAlpha, EqualWeighting, construcción de portafolio MeanVariance/Black-Litterman, modelos de ejecución y de riesgo por drawdown).

modules.summary: Compatibility layer of stubs and aliases for QuantConnect LEAN imports, including FeeModel, ConstantFeeModel, SlippageModel, VolumeShareSlippageModel, MarketImpactSlippageModel and the RiskParity/MeanReversion portfolio construction models.
modules.relevance_note: The default FeeModel returns 0, and VolumeShareSlippageModel, MarketImpactSlippageModel and RiskParityPortfolioConstructionModel are empty stubs. So LEAN strategies that model costs or use risk parity run here with no costs and no actual optimisation.
modules.summary_es: Capa de compatibilidad de stubs y alias para los imports de QuantConnect LEAN, incluidos FeeModel, ConstantFeeModel, SlippageModel, VolumeShareSlippageModel, MarketImpactSlippageModel y los modelos de construcción de portafolio RiskParity/MeanReversion.

modules.summary: UnconstrainedMeanVariancePortfolioOptimizer stub whose optimize() returns equal weights.
modules.relevance_note: Any 'mean-variance' or 'Black-Litterman' strategy using this optimiser actually holds 1/N, which happens to be the DeMiguel naive benchmark.
modules.summary_es: Stub de UnconstrainedMeanVariancePortfolioOptimizer cuyo optimize() devuelve pesos iguales.

modules.summary: Wrappers around the ta library for about 45 indicators: momentum (RSI, stochastic, Williams %R, ROC, TSI, KAMA, PPO), volume (OBV, CMF, MFI, VWAP), volatility, trend and returns, plus a CLI loader for yfinance/CSV/JSON.
modules.relevance_note: Computes indicators only. There is no trading rule, no backtest and no test of whether technical rules are profitable or survive data-snooping correction.
modules.summary_es: Wrappers sobre la biblioteca ta para unos 45 indicadores: momentum (RSI, estocástico, Williams %R, ROC, TSI, KAMA, PPO), volumen (OBV, CMF, MFI, VWAP), volatilidad, tendencia y rendimientos, además de un cargador CLI para yfinance/CSV/JSON.

modules.summary: Trend indicators: SMA, EMA, WMA, MACD, TRIX, Mass Index, Ichimoku, KST, DPO, CCI, ADX, Vortex, PSAR, STC and Aroon.
modules.relevance_note: Supplies the moving-average trend signals used in the MA-rule and trend-following literature, but has no position or performance logic.
modules.summary_es: Indicadores de tendencia: SMA, EMA, WMA, MACD, TRIX, Mass Index, Ichimoku, KST, DPO, CCI, ADX, Vortex, PSAR, STC y Aroon.

modules.summary: Volatility indicators: ATR, Bollinger Bands, Keltner Channel, Donchian Channel and Ulcer Index.
modules.relevance_note: Donchian channels allow breakout (turtle) rules and ATR allows volatility-scaled sizing, but nothing in the area uses them for vol targeting or a breakout backtest.
modules.summary_es: Indicadores de volatilidad: ATR, Bandas de Bollinger, Canal de Keltner, Canal de Donchian y Ulcer Index.

modules.summary: Single-stock, long-only backtest of an MA60 + RSI + MACD-histogram entry, with stop-loss, take-profit, max-hold and RSI exits and a buy-and-hold comparison.
modules.relevance_note: A gross backtest: no commissions or slippage, signal and fill on the same close, and a Sharpe ratio with no risk-free rate and no significance test.
modules.summary_es: Backtest de una sola acción, solo en largo, de una entrada MA60 + RSI + histograma del MACD, con salidas por stop-loss, take-profit, tenencia máxima y RSI, y una comparación contra buy-and-hold.

modules.summary: Candlestick-image pattern search: encodes chart images with an attention autoencoder, searches with FAISS, re-ranks with DTW, correlation and shape features, then labels each match with a triple barrier to produce win-rate stats.
modules.relevance_note: A chart-pattern forecaster that works by finding similar past charts. Matches are not required to come before the query date, and the win rate has no significance test or cost adjustment.
modules.summary_es: Búsqueda de patrones en imágenes de velas: codifica imágenes de gráficas con un autoencoder con atención, busca con FAISS, reordena con DTW, correlación y rasgos de forma, y luego etiqueta cada coincidencia con una triple barrera para producir estadísticas de tasa de acierto.

modules.summary: López de Prado triple-barrier labeler, a predictor that combines the labels of matched patterns into bullish/bearish probabilities, and a win/loss-ratio helper.
modules.relevance_note: Computes win rate and payoff ratio and labels them as Kelly inputs, but no Kelly fraction is computed or used anywhere in the area.
modules.summary_es: Etiquetador de triple barrera de López de Prado, un predictor que combina las etiquetas de los patrones coincidentes en probabilidades alcistas/bajistas, y un helper de razón ganancia/pérdida.

modules.summary: A 0-10 scorecard that adds pattern win-rate points, P/E and ROE points from yfinance and MA60/RSI/MACD technical points, then outputs BUY, WAIT or SELL.
modules.relevance_note: An ad-hoc value (P/E) and profitability (ROE) screen with arbitrary cut-offs. It uses current yfinance fundamentals (look-ahead bias if applied to past dates) and has never been backtested.
modules.summary_es: Tarjeta de puntuación de 0 a 10 que suma puntos por tasa de acierto del patrón, puntos de P/E y ROE de yfinance y puntos técnicos de MA60/RSI/MACD, y luego emite BUY, WAIT o SELL.

modules.summary: Downloads OHLCV, renders candlestick images, trains the AttentionCAE and builds the FAISS index. The default universe is a list of today's top-50 S&P 500 megacaps.
modules.relevance_note: The default universe is today's megacap winners (survivorship bias), and the model is trained on the same full history later searched for patterns.
modules.summary_es: Descarga OHLCV, genera imágenes de velas, entrena el AttentionCAE y construye el índice FAISS. El universo predeterminado es una lista de las 50 megacaps principales actuales del S&P 500.

modules.summary: Primary market-data script (one-shot CLI and framed daemon) for quotes, OHLCV history, info, financial statements, ratios (P/E, P/B, ROE, gross margin), news and portfolio NAV history.
modules.relevance_note: Feeds price and fundamental ratio inputs for momentum, value and quality across the terminal. It can fetch BMV tickers via the .MX suffix (mapped in src/ui/navigation/CommandBar_Assets.cpp) and ^MXX generically, but it is current-snapshot fundamentals with survivorship bias.
modules.summary_es: Script principal de datos de mercado (CLI de una sola ejecución y daemon con mensajes enmarcados) para cotizaciones, historial OHLCV, info, estados financieros, razones (P/E, P/B, ROE, margen bruto), noticias e historial de NAV del portafolio.

modules.summary: Native C++ bar-by-bar backtester for DSL condition strategies. Signals fire on bar close and fill at the next open; it handles SL/TP/trailing stop and fixed position_size_pct, and reports equity curve, buy-and-hold benchmark, max drawdown, profit factor and timeframe-annualised Sharpe/Sortino/Calmar.
modules.relevance_note: Produces only GROSS backtests (no commission, slippage or spread). It is called by AlgoTradingService::run_backtest for the Algo Trading Strategy Builder.
modules.area: fincept-qt/src C++ side: backtesting, ai_quant_lab, portfoli
modules.summary_es: Backtester nativo en C++, barra por barra, para estrategias de condiciones DSL. Las señales se disparan al cierre de la barra y se ejecutan en la siguiente apertura; maneja SL/TP/trailing stop y position_size_pct fijo, y reporta curva de capital, benchmark buy-and-hold, drawdown máximo, profit factor y Sharpe/Sortino/Calmar anualizados según la temporalidad.

modules.summary: Native C++ indicator library used by the algo engine and scanners: SMA/EMA/WMA/DEMA/TEMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, Keltner, Donchian, SuperTrend, Ichimoku, ADX, Aroon, ATR, CCI, Stochastic, Williams %R, ROC, OBV, CMF, MFI, VWAP-related.
modules.relevance_note: Calculation core for the technical trading rules (moving-average crossovers, channel breakouts) that the literature tests.
modules.area: fincept-qt/src C++ side: backtesting, ai_quant_lab, portfoli
modules.summary_es: Biblioteca nativa de indicadores en C++ que usan el algo engine y los scanners: SMA/EMA/WMA/DEMA/TEMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, Keltner, Donchian, SuperTrend, Ichimoku, ADX, Aroon, ATR, CCI, Stochastic, Williams %R, ROC, OBV, CMF, MFI e indicadores relacionados con VWAP.

modules.summary: Registers MCP tools that expose MAAnalyticsService's Python analytics to LLM agents: ma_black_litterman, ma_equity_risk_premium, ma_business_cycle, ma_am_information_ratio, the ma_skfolio_* tools (optimize, backtest, risk metrics, stress test), and ma_ffn_*, ma_functime_* and ma_gs_*.
modules.relevance_note: The only route by which equity_risk_premium.py, business_cycle.py and active_management.py reach the app (MCP only). ma_skfolio_backtest exposes the gross skfolio_service backtest, with no costs and no trial adjustment.
modules.summary_es: Registra herramientas MCP que exponen la analítica en Python de MAAnalyticsService a agentes LLM: ma_black_litterman, ma_equity_risk_premium, ma_business_cycle, ma_am_information_ratio, las herramientas ma_skfolio_* (optimización, backtest, métricas de riesgo, prueba de estrés), y ma_ffn_*, ma_functime_* y ma_gs_*.

modules.summary: AI Quant Lab screen shell: a sidebar grouped CORE/AI_ML/ADVANCED/ANALYTICS that creates a QuantModulePanel per module on demand.
modules.relevance_note: The user-facing entry point to every ML, factor and Qlib capability in the repo.
modules.area: fincept-qt/src C++ side: backtesting, ai_quant_lab, portfoli
modules.summary_es: Contenedor de la pantalla AI Quant Lab: una barra lateral agrupada en CORE/AI_ML/ADVANCED/ANALYTICS que crea un QuantModulePanel por módulo bajo demanda.

modules.summary: Renders factor evaluation (IC mean, ICIR, p-value, quantile stats, long-short Sharpe and mean return, turnover mean/median/max) and strategy_builder results (expected turnover, portfolio metrics).
modules.relevance_note: Marks a factor green when its IC p-value is below 0.05, a single-test threshold with no Bonferroni/Holm/BHY haircut. Turnover is shown but never netted against the long-short return.
modules.area: fincept-qt/src C++ side: backtesting, ai_quant_lab, portfoli
modules.summary_es: Muestra la evaluación de factores (media del IC, ICIR, valor p, estadísticas por cuantil, Sharpe y rendimiento medio long-short, rotación media/mediana/máxima) y los resultados de strategy_builder (rotación esperada, métricas del portafolio).

modules.summary: Qlib-style backtest panel. Strategy can be topk_dropout, weight_based or enhanced_indexing, with top-K and a Yahoo benchmark. Shows KPI cards, an equity vs benchmark chart, and an execution cost strip (commission_bps and expected_slippage_bps).
modules.relevance_note: Costs appear as a separate estimate strip. The UI does not show net-of-cost Sharpe next to gross Sharpe.
modules.area: fincept-qt/src C++ side: backtesting, ai_quant_lab, portfoli
modules.summary_es: Panel de backtest al estilo Qlib. La estrategia puede ser topk_dropout, weight_based o enhanced_indexing, con top-K y un benchmark de Yahoo. Muestra tarjetas de KPI, una gráfica de capital contra el benchmark y una franja de costos de ejecución (commission_bps y expected_slippage_bps).

modules.summary: Deep Agent (LangGraph) and RD-Agent tabs for autonomous LLM-driven factor mining, model optimisation and quant research tasks.
modules.relevance_note: LLM agents that generate and test many candidate factors automatically, the highest data-snooping risk in the app, with no multiple-testing haircut on the discovered factors.
modules.area: fincept-qt/src C++ side: backtesting, ai_quant_lab, portfoli
modules.summary_es: Pestañas de Deep Agent (LangGraph) y RD-Agent para tareas autónomas impulsadas por LLM de minería de factores, optimización de modelos e investigación cuantitativa.

modules.summary: Fortitudo panel: portfolio metrics, covariance, mean-variance and mean-CVaR optimisation, efficient frontier, exponential-decay probability weights.
modules.relevance_note: Mean-variance and CVaR portfolio construction, with exp-decay weights acting as a simple estimation-error mitigation.
modules.area: fincept-qt/src C++ side: backtesting, ai_quant_lab, portfoli
modules.summary_es: Panel de Fortitudo: métricas del portafolio, covarianza, optimización media-varianza y media-CVaR, frontera eficiente y pesos de probabilidad con decaimiento exponencial.

modules.summary: GS Quant panel: risk metrics, portfolio analytics, Greeks, VaR analysis, stress tests, a simple backtest and statistics through gs_quant_service.py.
modules.relevance_note: Risk and VaR/stress analytics plus a basic backtest, with no overfitting statistics.
modules.area: fincept-qt/src C++ side: backtesting, ai_quant_lab, portfoli
modules.summary_es: Panel de GS Quant: métricas de riesgo, analítica de portafolio, griegas, análisis de VaR, pruebas de estrés, un backtest simple y estadísticas a través de gs_quant_service.py.

modules.summary: HFT panel: live CCXT order book, Avellaneda-Stoikov market-making quotes, toxic-flow PIN score, and an order-book-walk slippage estimate.
modules.relevance_note: The only UI that estimates market-impact/slippage from depth. It is standalone and not fed back into any backtest.
modules.area: fincept-qt/src C++ side: backtesting, ai_quant_lab, portfoli
modules.summary_es: Panel HFT: libro de órdenes en vivo vía CCXT, cotizaciones de market making de Avellaneda-Stoikov, puntaje PIN de flujo tóxico y una estimación de slippage recorriendo el libro de órdenes.

modules.summary: Panels for Live Signals (factor analysis, feature importance), Online Learning (concept drift), Meta Learning (model selection/ensembles/hyperparameter tuning) and Rolling Retraining (default LightGBM+Alpha158).
modules.relevance_note: Rolling retraining works as walk-forward validation. Meta-learning model selection and hyperparameter tuning add trials that are never counted toward an overfitting adjustment.
modules.area: fincept-qt/src C++ side: backtesting, ai_quant_lab, portfoli
modules.summary_es: Paneles de Live Signals (análisis de factores, importancia de features), Online Learning (concept drift), Meta Learning (selección de modelos/ensambles/ajuste de hiperparámetros) y Rolling Retraining (LightGBM+Alpha158 por defecto).

modules.summary: Panels for Factor Discovery, Model Library (LightGBM/XGBoost/LSTM/Transformer), Advanced Models, Feature Engineering (IC-based feature selection, expression engine), Portfolio Opt (Black-Litterman with market caps, HRP, risk parity), Factor Evaluation, Strategy Builder (TopK-Dropout) and Data Processors.
modules.relevance_note: Covers the Gu-Kelly-Xiu-style ML return-prediction and factor-zoo workflow. IC-based feature selection is a data-mining step with no false-discovery control.
modules.area: fincept-qt/src C++ side: backtesting, ai_quant_lab, portfoli
modules.summary_es: Paneles de Factor Discovery, Model Library (LightGBM/XGBoost/LSTM/Transformer), Advanced Models, Feature Engineering (selección de features basada en IC, motor de expresiones), Portfolio Opt (Black-Litterman con capitalizaciones de mercado, HRP, paridad de riesgo), Factor Evaluation, Strategy Builder (TopK-Dropout) y Data Processors.

modules.summary: Quant Reporting panel with five report builders: IC analysis, cumulative returns, risk report, model performance, factor quantiles (qlib_reporting.py).
modules.relevance_note: Reports single-factor IC and quantile spreads, with no deflation for how many factors or models were tried.
modules.area: fincept-qt/src C++ side: backtesting, ai_quant_lab, portfoli
modules.summary_es: Panel de Quant Reporting con cinco generadores de reportes: análisis de IC, rendimientos acumulados, reporte de riesgo, desempeño del modelo y cuantiles de factores (qlib_reporting.py).

modules.summary: Statsmodels panel: OLS, ARIMA, ADF/KPSS stationarity, ACF/PACF, Granger causality and descriptive statistics.
modules.relevance_note: Generic tools that could run predictive and factor regressions. The statsmodels_wrapper's multipletests/FDR functions are not exposed in this panel.
modules.area: fincept-qt/src C++ side: backtesting, ai_quant_lab, portfoli
modules.summary_es: Panel de Statsmodels: OLS, ARIMA, estacionariedad ADF/KPSS, ACF/PACF, causalidad de Granger y estadística descriptiva.

modules.summary: Algo Trading Strategy Builder UI. Users compose entry/exit indicator conditions, load templates, run the native C++ backtest, view results and deploy live or paper (including F&O legs).
modules.relevance_note: Lets users iterate on rules against a single in-sample gross backtest, with no holdout, walk-forward or cost input. This invites data snooping.
modules.area: fincept-qt/src C++ side: backtesting, ai_quant_lab, portfoli
modules.summary_es: Interfaz del Strategy Builder de Algo Trading. Los usuarios componen condiciones de indicadores de entrada/salida, cargan plantillas, ejecutan el backtest nativo en C++, ven los resultados y despliegan en vivo o en paper (incluidas patas de F&O).

modules.summary: Analyzer forms for alternatives (hedge funds with hurdle rate, managed-futures/CTA funds with management and performance fees on gross return, market neutral, PE/VC, annuities, structured notes, leveraged ETFs, TIPS) that call Analytics/alternateInvestment/cli.py.
modules.relevance_note: Covers the fund-fee-drag side of the active-management literature using hypothetical inputs. There is no mutual-fund persistence or SPIVA-style data.
modules.area: fincept-qt/src C++ side: backtesting, ai_quant_lab, portfoli
modules.summary_es: Formularios de análisis para inversiones alternativas (hedge funds con hurdle rate, fondos de managed futures/CTA con comisiones de administración y de desempeño sobre el rendimiento bruto, market neutral, PE/VC, anualidades, notas estructuradas, ETFs apalancados, TIPS) que llaman a Analytics/alternateInvestment/cli.py.

modules.summary: Builds the JSON arguments for each backtesting command from UI widgets: capital, commission %, slippage %, leverage, position sizing, stop/take-profit, benchmark, risk-free rate, optimizer paramRanges/maxIterations, walk-forward splits/train ratio, splitter purge/embargo and label params.
modules.relevance_note: Commission (default 0.1%) and slippage (default 0.05%) are sent only for backtest/optimize/walk_forward. No n_trials count is ever sent, so no deflated-Sharpe correction can be applied to optimizer results.
modules.area: fincept-qt/src C++ side: backtesting, ai_quant_lab, portfoli
modules.summary_es: Construye los argumentos JSON de cada comando de backtesting a partir de los widgets de la UI: capital, % de comisión, % de slippage, apalancamiento, dimensionamiento de posición, stop/take-profit, benchmark, tasa libre de riesgo, paramRanges/maxIterations del optimizador, splits/proporción de entrenamiento del walk-forward, purge/embargo del splitter y parámetros de etiquetas.

modules.summary: Builds the Backtesting screen: the command list (Backtest, Optimize, Walk-Forward, Indicators, ML Labels, CV Splits, Returns) and the execution section, whose commission spin box defaults to 0.1% and slippage spin box to 0.05%.
modules.relevance_note: BacktestingScreen_Commands.cpp sends these defaults as commission and slippage for backtest, optimize and walk_forward, so runs on vectorbt, backtesting.py and bt from the UI include costs. The fincept provider still sets fees to zero, and there is no field for the number of trials or a deflated Sharpe.
modules.summary_es: Construye la pantalla de Backtesting: la lista de comandos (Backtest, Optimize, Walk-Forward, Indicators, ML Labels, CV Splits, Returns) y la sección de ejecución, cuyo spin box de comisión tiene 0.1% por defecto y el de slippage 0.05%.

modules.summary: Renders provider results: summary cards, a generic metrics key/value table, trades, walk-forward window tables (avgOosReturn, avgOosSharpe, robustnessScore, degradationRatio), CV split folds and returns analysis.
modules.relevance_note: Shows out-of-sample walk-forward degradation and any metric Python returns, including vectorbt's 'deflatedSharpe'. That figure only adjusts for skew and kurtosis and does not account for the number of trials.
modules.area: fincept-qt/src C++ side: backtesting, ai_quant_lab, portfoli
modules.summary_es: Muestra los resultados del proveedor: tarjetas de resumen, una tabla genérica clave/valor de métricas, operaciones, tablas de ventanas walk-forward (avgOosReturn, avgOosSharpe, robustnessScore, degradationRatio), folds de splits de CV y análisis de rendimientos.

modules.summary: About 35 Economics screen data panels (FRED, BEA, BLS, Census, Fed, ECB, Eurostat, ONS, IMF, World Bank, OECD, BIS, ADB, EconDb, Trading Economics, CFTC, NBER, BCB Brazil, Global Central Banks, UN Comtrade, WTO, EIA, etc.), each calling its own *_data.py.
modules.relevance_note: Broad macro data coverage. Global Central Banks covers BOE/RBA/BoC/Riksbank/SNB/Norges/CNB/NBP/MNB/BNR/HNB/TCMB/BOI/BNM, BCB is the only Latin American central bank, and Mexico appears only as a country code in the IMF/EconDb/WorldBank/UN Comtrade selectors.

modules.summary_es: Unos 35 paneles de datos de la pantalla Economics (FRED, BEA, BLS, Census, Fed, ECB, Eurostat, ONS, IMF, World Bank, OECD, BIS, ADB, EconDb, Trading Economics, CFTC, NBER, BCB Brazil, Global Central Banks, UN Comtrade, WTO, EIA, etc.), cada uno de los cuales llama a su propio *_data.py.

modules.summary: CFTC Commitments of Traders panel with cot_data, market_sentiment and cot_historical_trend for 40+ futures markets, plus a sentiment widget.
modules.relevance_note: Positioning-sentiment data for futures. It is not linked to any TSMOM or sentiment-timing backtest.

modules.summary_es: Panel de Commitments of Traders de la CFTC con cot_data, market_sentiment y cot_historical_trend para más de 40 mercados de futuros, además de un widget de sentimiento.

modules.summary: Composite FRED dataset views (yield curve, spreads and other multi-series analytics) from fred_economic_data.py.

modules.summary_es: Vistas compuestas de datasets de FRED (curva de rendimiento, spreads y otras analíticas de múltiples series) a partir de fred_economic_data.py.

modules.summary: Shows NBER Business Cycle Dating Committee US recession peaks/troughs from nber_data.py.

modules.summary_es: Muestra los picos y valles de recesión de EE. UU. del NBER Business Cycle Dating Committee a partir de nber_data.py.

modules.summary: Single-stock valuation tab: DCF, multiples (EV/EBITDA, Graham number), and Altman Z / Piotroski F / Beneish scores via QuantLibClient endpoints such as analysis/valuation/predictive/altman-z.

modules.summary_es: Pestaña de valuación de una sola acción: DCF, múltiplos (EV/EBITDA, número de Graham) y puntajes Altman Z / Piotroski F / Beneish mediante endpoints de QuantLibClient como analysis/valuation/predictive/altman-z.

modules.summary: FFN analytics tab: overview stats, rebased performance, drawdowns, rolling metrics, benchmark comparison and optimisation output from ffn_analysis.py.
modules.relevance_note: Performance measurement against a benchmark, with no significance or alpha t-statistics.
modules.area: fincept-qt/src C++ side: backtesting, ai_quant_lab, portfoli
modules.summary_es: Pestaña de analítica FFN: estadísticas generales, desempeño rebasado, drawdowns, métricas móviles, comparación contra el benchmark y resultados de optimización desde ffn_analysis.py.

modules.summary: Custom index builder with price-, cap-, equal- (1/N), float-, fundamental-, factor-, inverse-vol (risk parity), geometric and capped weighting, plus index performance.

modules.summary_es: Constructor de índices personalizados con ponderación por precio, por capitalización, igual (1/N), por flotante, fundamental, por factores, por volatilidad inversa (paridad de riesgo), geométrica y con tope, además del desempeño del índice.

modules.summary_es: Pestaña macro del portafolio: niveles macro de FRED vía EconomicsService (fred_data.py) y una 'sensibilidad del portafolio a factores' calculada con betas por sector fijas en el código frente a tasas/crecimiento/inflación/USD/petróleo, ponderadas por las posiciones.

modules.summary: Retirement, savings and goals planner. Corpus target = expense / withdrawal rate (4% default), inflation-adjusted real return, and a native 2,000-run fixed-seed normal Monte Carlo giving p5/p50/p95 wealth and success probability.

gaps.text: El Deflated Sharpe del repositorio está mal escalado y desconectado: compara el Sharpe con E[max SR] = √(2·ln N)·(…) en unidades z sin multiplicarlo por la desviación del Sharpe, recibe n_trials = 1 por defecto y ningún optimizador le pasa el número de combinaciones que probó.
gaps.covered_by: quant_evidence.stats.deflated_sharpe_ratio implementa la versión de Bailey y López de Prado (verificada con el ejemplo DSR = 0.90).

gaps.text: No existe probabilidad de sobreajuste del backtest (PBO/CSCV), Reality Check de White, SPA de Hansen ni stepdown de Romano-Wolf. Hay generadores de validación combinatoria purgada, pero nada calcula el PBO.

Las correcciones por pruebas múltiples existen solo como funciones sin usar (multipletests, fdrcorrection en el wrapper de statsmodels): no están registradas en el servicio ni en el CLI, y los barridos de parámetros y la selección de factores Alpha158 por |IC| se reportan sin corrección.
gaps.covered_by: quant_evidence.stats.haircut_sharpe y bonferroni_t_threshold aplican el recorte de Harvey y Liu y el umbral t > 3.

gaps.text: Hay fugas de información en los pipelines de ML: qlib_service.train_model usa el mismo periodo para validación y prueba, quant_modules_3042 valida con KFold sin purgar y la búsqueda de patrones de vision_quant no se restringe a fechas anteriores a la consulta.

Algunas herramientas devuelven cifras fijas en lugar de calcularlas: las herramientas del agente RenTech reportan Sharpe 2.1, Sharpe neto 1.85 y 15% de degradación fuera de muestra, y el comando 'backtest' del wrapper de skfolio devuelve métricas de relleno.

Los costos se tratan de forma inconsistente: fincept_provider fija comisión y slippage en 0.0, vectorbt y backtesting.py usan comisión 0 cuando la petición no la trae (la pantalla de backtesting sí envía 0.1% y 0.05%, pero MCP y CLI no), los backtests de los optimizadores son brutos y ningún motor reporta rotación realizada ni rendimiento neto frente a bruto.
gaps.covered_by: quant_evidence.stats.monthly_cost_bps y breakeven_roundtrip_cost_bps calculan el costo por rotación y el costo que anula la ventaja.

gaps.text: No hay filtros de microcaps, precio o liquidez en el universo de las señales; skfolio_data aproxima el tamaño con log(precio) y el valor con 1/precio, y SykesShortMicroCapAlpha opera acciones de menos de 5 dólares sin comisiones. La evidencia indica que entre 48% y 71% del alfa de machine learning desaparece al excluir microcaps.
gaps.covered_by: El evaluador descuenta la parte del alfa en microcaps.

gaps.text: No hay pipeline Fama-French, Carhart ni q-factor: no se descargan esos factores, ninguna regresión multifactor reporta t de alfa y ninguna regresión expuesta usa errores de Newey-West.

No hay carteras largo-corto por deciles: ni momentum de corte transversal 12-1 (el mes de salto solo aparece en una prueba de un solo activo que nada invoca), ni valor (HML), rentabilidad (GP/A, QMJ) o betting-against-beta.

Varios asignadores no hacen lo que dice su nombre: en bt_strategies 'target_vol' ignora la volatilidad objetivo y 'min_var' usa WeighMeanVar; en portfolio_optimization 'hrp' es inverso de la varianza sin clustering y 'black_litterman' no tiene vistas; en fincept_engine el optimizador media-varianza devuelve 1/N.
Se descargan CAPE, rendimiento por dividendo y diferenciales de tasas, pero no hay regresiones predictivas, R² fuera de muestra frente a la media histórica ni prueba de Clark-West.
gaps.covered_by: quant_evidence.stats.campbell_thompson_gain traduce un R² fuera de muestra a ganancia esperada.

gaps.text: Ningún GARCH se estima localmente: garch_volatility usa parámetros fijos (ω = 1e-6, α = 0.1, β = 0.85) y la volatilidad 'tipo GARCH' del agente RenTech es en realidad EWMA. Los modelos de cambio de régimen de statsmodels existen pero no están expuestos en el CLI ni en el servicio.
Se descargan VIX, VIX3M, VVIX y SKEW, pero nada calcula la prima de riesgo de varianza (implícita menos realizada), y el interés corto solo existe como dato puntual de yfinance, sin historia.

Las pruebas de calendario se limitan a día de la semana, mes y enero en market_efficiency.detect_calendar_anomalies, con p < 0.05 sin corrección y sin ningún llamador; no hay cambio de mes, pre-FOMC ni feriados.
No hay analítica para México: ni IPC (^MXX), Banxico, INEGI, CETES ni EWW; BMV y BIVA solo aparecen como sufijos '.MX', y el benchmark por defecto para MXN es SPY.
gaps.covered_by: El evaluador aplica costos 1.5× y advertencias de universo pequeño para el mercado mexicano.

gaps.text: Las variantes de Kelly del repositorio son discretas (tasa de acierto y pagos) y algunas se truncan arbitrariamente; no había Kelly continuo μ/σ² ni Kelly fraccionario bajo error de estimación.

La planeación de retiro en Python es determinista (rendimiento fijo de 7% y regla de 4%). La vista de planeación en C++ sí corre 2,000 trayectorias con aportaciones, pero sin fase de retiros, trayectoria por edad ni colas gruesas.
Las señales de noticias, sentimiento y agentes LLM no se registran contra rendimientos futuros (sin IC ni tasa de acierto), así que no hay forma de medir si predicen.
No hay comparativas tipo SPIVA de fondos activos frente al índice ni análisis de comportamiento minorista; behavioral_finance.py y etf_analytics.py son esqueletos con solo docstrings.

corrections.issue: The mexico_latam tag is unsupported. The file has no Mexico or LatAm code: default_benchmark_for_currency has branches only for CAD, GBP, EUR, AUD, INR, JPY and HKD, so MXN (and BRL) fall back to SPY. Use it as gap evidence, not as a mexico_latam module.
The mexico_latam tag is unsupported. default_global_markets has no ^MXX, ^BVSP, USDMXN or LatAm ETF; the only Latin American item is the BRL symbol 'R$' in the currency-symbol map.

The mexico_latam tag is unsupported. It is a generic source dispatcher with no LatAm reference (grep for bcb, brazil, iadb and mexico finds nothing). The only Latin American economics content is BcbPanel.cpp (Brazil) in screens/economics/panels.

The mexico_latam tag overstates the content. Its LatAm exposure is only ECH, EWZ, GXG and ILF. The Mexico ETF EWW is missing, and EWM (Malaysia) appears three times in the ticker list. All fees are set to ConstantFeeModel(0).

low_beta_bab is a stretch, since there is only a min_volatility objective and no beta sort. The summary should also flag mislabelled allocators: 'hrp' is plain inverse-variance weighting with no clustering, and 'black_litterman' uses the equal-weight equilibrium prior with no views, so it reduces to max-Sharpe on implied returns.

The position_sizing_kelly tag is weak. The file has margin-account and leverage-ratio mechanics (MarginAccountData, MarginTradingCalculator) but no Kelly or position-sizing logic. trading_costs_turnover is correct.

The categories are fine, but no CLI, service or C++ screen imports this module, so it is unreachable. The summary should also note that detect_momentum_anomaly does use a 12-1 skip-month window, on a single asset's own history; that detect_size_anomaly sorts one asset's history by its own market cap, which is not cross-sectional; and that mutual_fund_performance_analysis reports per-fund CAPM alpha t-stats and the share of funds with significant alpha.

The long_horizon_lifecycle tag is correct, but the map's gap statements contradict the file. PlanningView::monte_carlo runs 2000 paths of normal annual returns with annual contributions and reports goal-success probability and the p5/p50/p95 bands. There is still no withdrawal phase, glide path or fat-tail/sequence risk.

This is static seed-knowledge text (strategy write-ups, including a quarter-Kelly methodology and turnover targets), not computing code. The momentum and technical_rules tags describe documents, not implementations; if kept, it should be marked as text, and position_sizing_kelly would fit its content better.
